name: Madhavan Ananthachari
designation: Lead Architect, TCS AWS Business unit
bio: With over 17 years in TCS, Madhavan Ananthachari is one of the lead architects in TCS’ AWS business unit. He has worked with multiple companies globally to provide solutions in cloud technologies and IT modernization.

name: Madhavi Satguru
bio: Madhavi Satguru has over 20 years of experience in CRM advisory and transformation across insurance, telecom, banking, and retail industries. As an innovation and solutions leader of the Oracle CX team in TCS, she drives digital growth and transformation in the customer experience arena across geographies.

name: Madhura Kulkarni
designation: Head of Marketing, TCS Chroma™
bio: Madhura leads marketing for TCS Chroma. A seasoned communication professional and a GTM strategist with a growth mindset, Madhura brings a diversified experience of more than 15 years across the Marketing and Mass Communication domains. She is an alumnus of the prestigious Indian Institute of Management, Kolkata, and NM State University, USA.

name: Madhuri Urkude
designation: Consultant
bio: Leading teams through all the challenges to success in an appreciative environment helps me to learn and keeps me motivated to achieve more. The abundance of growth opportunities makes each day fruitful. It’s just a matter of accepting the challenge which comes along!

name: Magna Hadley
designation: Vice President, Global Domain Head, Healthcare, TCS
bio: Magna Hadley is a Vice President with TCS and serves as the Global Healthcare Advisor. She has over 30 years of experience in defining, leading strategic business solutions and technology-enabled transformations both in the US and global markets. Her work includes extensive experience with national and regional payer-provider organizations and pharmacy benefit manager (PBM). Magna brings a rich experience in helping healthcare businesses re-invent themselves through business and IT transformation. She is a member of the National Association for Female Executives (NAFE). Magna serves on the Board of Women United; United Way of Monmouth County. She supports TCS’s goIT program and encourages young women on new-age technologies and career opportunities in STEM. TCS is one of the founders of One Million Women Mentors Program and Magna is a speaker and supporter of this program.

name: Mahadevan Chidambaram
bio: Mahadevan Chidambaram is an Industry Advisor with TCS’ Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit. He comes with 23 years of industry experience, having spent nine years in banking operations, two years in solution development, and more than 11 years in consulting, alongside a year in international public private partnerships. He is a key member of TCS’ banking thought leadership group that assists clients with business, technology, and digital transformation needs, and provides advisory services to help transform the enterprise and drive growth objectives. He has a Master’s degree in Business Administration from the K.J. Somaiya Institute of Management Studies, Mumbai, India.

name: Mahendra Hasabnis
designation: Business Head Pharma Manufacturing Engineering and Industrial Services - Life Sciences, TCS
bio: Mahendra Hasabnis is the Global Business Head of the Pharmaceutical Manufacturing group within TCS Product Engineering business unit. He has over 20 years of experience in engineering and manufacturing IT services and has anchored several transformation initiatives for global companies. In his current role, Hasabnis is responsible for growth and sustenance of engineering and manufacturing IT services, and development of next-gen solutions across TCS pharmaceutical clients. He has a Bachelors degree in Instrumentation Engineering from the Pravara Rural Engineering College, University Of Pune, Maharashtra, India.

name: Mahesh Gothal
designation: Center Head, India, TCS Salesforce Practice
bio: As India Center Head for TCS Salesforce Practice, Mahesh has been instrumental in building one of the fastest-growing salesforce consulting practices in the world. His rich experience of over 24 years spans a wide range of technologies, management, and leadership roles. Mahesh has leveraged the best of people, processes, and leading-edge technologies to deliver world-class solutions. He enjoys the challenge of building high-performing teams in a rapidly growing business environment.

name: Mahesh Kshirsagar
designation: TCS
bio: Mahesh has a vast experience of about 24 years across various technologies. He has played a key role in addressing ever-changing demands from the business by architecting state-of-the-art IT solutions. As a technology leader, he has successfully incubated several high impact, high revenue potential IT service lines and technology centers of excellence (CoE). His expertise spans various technology and architecture domains, and while he has been associated with various industry verticals, he has worked most extensively in Banking and Financial Services.

name: Mahesh P
designation: ANZ LATAM Industry Advisor and Engineering Lead for TCS Contexify™ CMI, TCS
bio: Mahesh P is an Industry Advisor for Australia, New Zealand and LATAM, CMI, TCS and engineering lead for TCS Contexify™. He has around 15 years of experience in consulting and delivering various customer experience transformation initiatives in India and the Middle East. He is a telecom domain expert specialized in BSS, contact center platforms. He is passionate about designing and building high impact systems to deliver delightful customer experiences.

name: Mahesh Rangarajan
bio: Mahesh Rangarajan is a TCS distinguished engineer and head of Semantic Systems Accelerator at TCS Research. He has over 23 years of industry experience addressing diverse industry requirements and programs. He holds a Master’s in Computer Science from the University of Pune, India, and a Master’s in Strategic Management from ICFAI, India.

name: Manasi Agarwal
designation: Lead, Sustainability and Circular Economy, Manufacturing, TCS
bio: Manasi Agarwal is the Initiative Lead for Sustainability and Circular Economy for Manufacturing at TCS. She comes with over 18 years of experience in sustainability and climate change initiatives, energy management, digital strategy formulation, plant operations, and technical services. Her current focus is to consult and enable customers for future sustainability and circular economy needs, unearthing new business models driven by sustainable ecosystems, data, and technology. She supports the development of cutting-edge sustainability offerings for her customers.

name: Manas Saha
designation: Technical Architect, TCS ADD™
bio: Manas is currently working as a Technical Architect with TCS ADD and is actively working on products and IP development for the platform. Manas has worked on various clinical trial and data management process improvement and automation ideas, AI/ML implementation in the clinical trial landscape, cloud migration, and technology upgrade and modernization.

name: Manish Bhobe
designation: Consulting Partner
bio: Manish Bhobe has over 25 years of experience with TCS and has led many successful customer engagements across domains such as banking, financial services, and insurance (BFSI), including capital markets; communications, media, and information (CMI) services. He brings diverse experience across pre-sales, practice management, customer relationship and delivery management, and software development. He is passionate about technology and loves to dabble in the fields of artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and data science. In his present role, Manish is leading the sustainability and industry ecosystems track within TCS’ AWS business solutions team. He is responsible for the GTM of TCS’ sustainability solutions and the development and promotion of multi-industry and cross-industry solutions using the breadth of AWS services. Manish is an AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner.

name: Manish Dubey
designation: Segment Head - Media & Entertainment, TCS
bio: Manish Dubey, Segment Head - Media & Entertainment, TCS Bio: With over 25 years of experience in the Media and Entertainment industry, Manish has led large scale technology transformation projects and agile transformation in a globally distributed model, while developing lasting relationships with customer CxOs. He is an Electronics and Telecommunication engineer from the Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology, Bhopal, India.

name: Manish Mishra
designation: Chief Technology Officer, Manufacturing, TCS
bio: Manish Mishra is the CTO and head of innovation for TCS’ Manufacturing business group. In this capacity, he has collaborated with inspiring leaders and talented teams to establish a highly acclaimed digital practice and enable the business group to consistently achieve the highest digital revenue. With deep expertise in full-stack technology, design thinking methodology, and industry and domain know-how, Manish’s mission has always been to deliver value to customers and create long-lasting impact. Over the course of his career, Manish has gained a wealth of experience in driving innovation, digital transformation, and enterprise-wide AI cloud adoption strategies for large and complex enterprises.

name: Manish Mandal
designation: Enterprise architect
bio: Manish is an enterprise architect working in the Communications, Media, and Information Services business unit of TCS. His expertise lies in AI-ML engineering for datasets and holds patents for his work in this field. Manish has done extensive work in finance and information services.

name: Manish Singh
designation: Solution Consultant, manufacturing, TCS-India
bio: Manish is a Solution Consultant for the manufacturing and life sciences domain focusing on India geography. He has over a decade of experience in the IT industry. Manish has experience working in delivery operations in the telecom domain and has been associated with digital marketing solutions. He has extensive experience in technologies in the MFG 4.0 domain and other technology areas, such as Python, Machine Learning, and Web Analytics Tools.

name: Manoj Apte
designation: Principal scientist, TCS Research
bio: Manoj is a principal scientist with TCS Research and is working with TCS since 1997. His interests include developing applications of machine learning and data mining in fraud and money laundering detection. He holds a Master’s in Technology in Industrial Management from the Indian Institute of Technology, Madras. Manoj has published 35 research papers in international journals, conferences, and books.

name: Manoj M
designation: Senior cloud solution designer
bio: Manoj is a senior cloud solution designer with TCS’ Communications, Media, and Information Services (CMI) business unit. He has over 14 years of experience in IT and telecom and is a part of the video and content services business group. His expertise lies in designing and building video streaming solutions in cloud for a wide group of TCS clients in their transformation journeys in media and broadcasting industries.

name: Manoj Reddy
designation: Lead, Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance, TCS - North America
bio: Manoj Reddy is a Domain Consultant with the Banking and Financial Services (BFS) business unit at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). With an overall experience of more than 13 years in the areas of financial services, IT, and business consulting, he is currently the Risk and Compliance Management Head for TCS' North America banking portfolio. Reddy has anchored several risk consulting and implementation engagements for financial firms the world over. He has also successfully led various business architecture consulting and design projects in the ERM and regulatory compliance management areas, for financial institutions in the US. Reddy is responsible for developing solutions and frameworks around Basel III, liquidity risk, CCAR, as well as DFAST guidelines.

name: Manonmani P
designation: Senior Research Analyst, BFSI – Sustainable Banking
bio: Manonmani P is an ESG research analyst in the BFSI – Sustainable Banking team. Her areas of expertise are sustainable finance, environmental regulations, climate change mitigation and adaptation, and climate justice. She is GARP certified as a Sustainability and Climate Risk Professional. Her experiences include critical analysis of financial institutions' sustainability strategies and performances.

name: Mansha Dhingra
bio: Mansha Dhingra works with the TCS Manufacturing marketing team as a content writer, researcher, and editor. An avid blogger, Mansha is deeply committed to creating compelling content across all digital platforms. She has also worked with strategic planners, business owners, and other creative team members to conceptualize, develop, and produce brand stories. An English post-graduate from University of Delhi, she had a stint with reputed media organizations, including NDTV and India Today.

name: Matt Clark
designation: Consulting Partner, Retail, TCS
bio: Matt is a consulting partner with TCS’ Retail Business Consulting Services group. He has over 30 years of retail experience and deep knowledge of store operations, project management, commercial and space strategies, and range and display strategies. He has held senior management roles in one of the UK’s largest retailers and has been at the heart of significant change and optimization programs. He works with retailers globally to unearth value end-to-end through the product lifecycle.

name: Matthew Lekstutis
bio: Matthew Lekstutis is the Supply Chain Consulting Lead for Tata Consultancy Services. He has over 20 years of experience as an industry executive and advisor including COO level P&L management responsibility. Matt helps clients to capture business performance improvement opportunities and drive growth by enabling new business models and technologies across the supply chain.

name: Dr. Mayank Mishra
designation: Senior Scientist, TCS Research
bio: Dr. Mayank Mishra is part of "Computing Systems Research Group" at TCS. His research group focusses on High Performance Computing (HPC) involving both software and hardware systems. He is involved in building frameworks and platforms for high performance Machine Learning and Deep Learning applications. Follow Dr. Mayank Mishra on social media

name: Mayukh Das
bio: Senior Research Analyst, Corporate Marketing Research, TCS Mayukh has over nine years of experience and assists the global sales and marketing teams with market and competitive intelligence for sales enablement and opportunity mining, consulting, strategic research and advisory.

name: Megan Wright
designation: North America Sport Sponsorship Manager, TCS
bio: Megan oversees the runner services across all North America sponsorships, including the TCS New York City Marathon, TCS Toronto Waterfront Marathon, Chicago Marathon, and Boston Marathon. She primarily leads runner services, expo, and hospitality offerings for the TCS NYC Marathon, and she serves as the project manager for TCS’ activations at the Chicago and Boston Marathons. Skilled in customer service and anticipating needs, she has revamped the runner experience, making the TCS Run Club a truly world-class experience for its runners, which include executives from TCS customers as well as other VIP guests and fellow TCS employees. Team TCS Teachers is a core group of the Club. Megan helped create Team TCS Teachers—a program that celebrates the transformational impact of educators in the lives of their students by awarding a select group of teachers with the opportunity to run TCS races—and has led the program since its inception in 2018.

name: Meghna Bajpai
bio: Starting her journey with the TCS Talent Acquisition team in 2014, Meghna has explored multiple roles throughout her tenure. From being a recruiter to being part of the first RPO on-shore Knowledge Transfer (KT) team and now handling the location lead role for Kolkata, she attributes her zeal to learn and the multitude of opportunities offered within TCS to be key to her growth. Living by the mantra, ‘change is the only constant’, Megha believes continuous upskilling is the defining factor to success.

name: Michale Murphy
designation: Executive Director
bio: Michael D. Murphy leads the PV Operations team within Global Patient Safety at Amgen, a position he has held since April 2019. Responsibilities include overseeing and managing teams accountable for adverse event case processing and medical review, periodic reporting, safety reporting obligations for clinical, commercial/marketing programs, and oversight of the safety technologies. Michael has over 20 years of experience within the pharmaceutical industry, focused within Pharmacovigilance, with expertise in Change Management, Process Excellence, and Safety Systems

name: Michele Lemmens
designation: Head of Business Sustainability and CTO, TCS APAC
bio: Michele is the CTO and Head of Business Sustainability for TCS APAC region. She is responsible for championing, shaping, and bringing to life new sustainability initiatives with stakeholders. She facilitates access to the depth and breadth of TCS capabilities, solutions, Research & Innovation and COIN partnership to deliver measurable economic, social, environmental outcomes that have industry relevance and value. Michele has over 25 years of consulting experience in both mature and emerging markets, evangelising sustainability and ESG, forging digital transformation and innovation pathways and curating new models for banking, financial services, and insurance. She brings considerable experience building collaboration in multi-stakeholder initiatives, leading the formulation of new business and revenue models often driven by new market entry or expansion strategies that have M&A, joint ventures, startups, and strategic alliances as core pillars.

name: Mihir Patel
designation: Lead, Business Solutions for Capital Markets, AWS Business Unit, TCS
bio: Mihir Patel leads business solutions for capital markets in TCS’ AWS Business Unit. With more than 20 years in TCS, he has led many strategic customer engagements globally and provided key solutions to address clients’ needs. His specializations include enterprise architecture and cloud technologies.

name: Mike Barry
designation: Strategic Advisor on Sustainable Business, TCS
bio: Mike is a change agent committed to helping businesses, big and small, new and established, prepare for and succeed in the great sustainability disruption that will wash through the economy in the 2020s. Mike was, until 2019, Director of Sustainable Business at Marks & Spencer, spearheading its ground-breaking sustainability program. He co-chaired the Consumer Goods Forum’s sustainability work bringing the world’s largest retailers and fast-moving consumer goods brands together to work on issues such as deforestation, plastics and forced labour. He is a Senior Associate at the Cambridge Institute for Sustainability Leadership and a Trustee at Blueprint for Better Business.

name: M Indira Priyadarsini
designation: Head, Solution and Delivery, Sustainable Banking and Investments, BFSI, TCS
bio: M Indira Priyadarsini (Indu) heads Solution and Delivery in the Sustainable Banking and Investments group in the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit at TCS. She has over 30 years of industry experience working in development banking, public service delivery, and sustainability programs for both private and public sector clients. Indu has also played leadership roles in consulting, solution delivery, business development, relationship management, and in developing solution frameworks for social sectors and sustainability (environmental, social, and governance). She specializes in impact tracking and performance management of public programs, social projects, and ESG initiatives, in addition to tracking carbon footprint in sustainable operations and business of financial institutions with various solution alternatives. Indu holds a bachelor’s degree in computer science and a master’s degree in management. She is an individual member of the Institution of Management Consultants of India.

name: Mohanraj Karuppusamy
designation: Associate Consultant, TCS Manufacturing
bio: Mohanraj Karuppusamy is a domain consultant at TCS with over 14 years of experience in the manufacturing sector. He has worked extensively in sales, after-sales, warranty, and service parts management areas for automobile and industrial machinery companies. Mohanraj is involved in several consulting and transformation engagements covering customer experience aspects like contact center, parts management, and customer self-service for TCS’ clients worldwide. He has a Master’s degree in Business Administration from the Great Lakes Institute of Management, Chennai, India.

name: Monica Mendonca
designation: Business Analyst and Subject Matter Expert, TCS ADD™ Data Management
bio: Monica Mendonca is part of TCS ADD™ Life Sciences Platforms at TCS. In her current role, she is the business analyst and subject matter expert for the Clinical Data Management domain within TCS ADDTM Platforms. She has close to a decade of experience in the areas of clinical operations and clinical data management.

name: Monika Bomba
designation: Sustainability consultant, TCS Manufacturing
bio: Monika is a sustainability consultant with more than 16 years of experience in the automotive industry. She advises organizations to adopt sustainable business practices in manufacturing. She also works on a wide range of environmental issues including end of life vehicles and batteries, chemical regulation, energy efficiency and carbon reduction schemes, and ISO standards. Monika has a master’s degree in environmental science from Maria Curie-Sklodowska University, Lublin, Poland.

name: Monodip Chakravarty
designation: Retail & CPG Transformation Lead | Saudi Arabia & Bahrain
bio: Monodip is a Data Quality Expert and has worked with leading retailers across the globe. Monodip is passionate about product development and innovation. Monodip has been instrumental in guiding multiple retailers in their transformation journey.

name: Mounir Merhi
bio: Mounir Merhi is the OSS Consulting Partner and segment head for North America in TCS’ Networks Solutions and Services unit. He works with TCS’ global customers on OSS digital transformation strategies and architecture roadmaps for next-generation networks. With over 30 years of professional experience, Mounir has worked in telecom labs, communication service providers, and leading technology companies. His areas of expertise lie in systems engineering, enterprise architecture, application integration, pre-sales engineering, software design and development, and deployment of mission-critical OSS, BSS, and IT enterprise systems.

name: Murali Poduval
designation: Head, Presales, Marketing and Alliances, Incubation, TCS
bio: Dr Murali Poduval is a Senior Consultant in the Life Sciences Engineering Group. He has over 25 years of experience in orthopedic surgery, specializing in joint replacement, deformity correction, and related technologies. Dr Poduval holds a Master of Surgery in Orthopedics from GS Medical College, and a Post Graduate Diploma in Management from LN Welingkar Institute of Management (WE School), in Mumbai, India.

name: Murugan Sivasubramania
designation: Leader, Digital Experience & Commerce, TCS North America
bio: Murugan is a digital experience leader focusing on channels and commerce at TCS. He has over 14 years’ experience in leading business and digital transformation initiatives for Fortune 100 companies across distribution, CPG, hitech, retail and manufacturing industries. He is responsible for defining and driving digital transformation narratives in preparing customers for the future of digital B2B sales, spanning the front, mid and back office functions. Murugan is based in the Chicago region and is an alum of Great Lakes Institute of Management and Anna University, Chennai

name: Muthulakshmi N
designation: Entrepreneur-in-Residence at TCS
bio: Lakshmi is Entrepreneur-in-Residence at TCS, incubating innovative ideas into new business opportunities. Lakshmi has 20 years of experience, held leadership positions as Head of Industry Solutions Practice in Google Business Unit and Head of Intelligent Process Automation practice. She is passionate about automation and artificial intelligence, and applying them to solve customer problems. Lakshmi holds a Bachelor of Engineering degree from Government College of Engineering, Tirunelveli and Senior Management Program in Indian Institute of Management, Ahmedabad.

name: Nagarajan Karuppiah
bio: Nagarajan Karuppiah heads the ML and AI CoE, Retail. He has been with TCS for over 20 years and has held various leadership positions across retail accounts. An active member of IEEE, he has published white papers on diverse topics from enterprise data warehouses to decision sciences. Nagarajan is currently focusing on building ML solutions, NLP for personalization and recommender systems for retailers. He can be reached at LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/nagarajank/?originalSubdomain=in

name: Nagarajan Venkatesan
designation: Domain Consultant, AWS Business Unit
bio: Nagarajan Venkatesan is a consultant in the Amazon Web Services Business Unit of TCS. He has almost 30 years of experience in the IT industry, spanning domains that include life insurance, health insurance, and annuities, as well as technologies such as cloud, IoT, and blockchain. He has a fellowship from the Insurance Institute of India and a fellowship from the Life Office Management Association, US. His current area of interest is the use of cloud-based technologies such as blockchain, AI, and machine learning in the insurance industry.

name: Nagarjuna Challa
designation: Managing Consultant
bio: Nagarjuna Challa is a Data and Cloud Consultant. He has 21 years of experience in architecting, consulting, and developing modern analytics platforms, digital analytics, data warehouses, data governance, and management, cloud migration, and implementation of data platforms on Azure, GCP, and AWS.

name: Nagendra Kumar
designation: Practice Innovation, Integrated Consulting Solutions
bio: Nagendra Kumar is a senior practitioner with more than 17 years of wide-ranging experience in technology, consulting, and general management across diverse business domains and technology platforms. As part of the Integrated Offerings group at Tata Consultancy Services' (TCS') Global Consultancy Practice (GCP), Nagendra is responsible for conceptualizing innovative consulting solutions and services to address CXO priorities and challenges. As a consultant, he advises global businesses on digital transformation, globalization, and M&A-driven growth strategies. Nagendra holds a Master's degree in Management from the Indian Institute of Management, Calcutta, and a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from the Indian Institute of Technology, New Delhi.

name: Narayanan R
designation: Chief Architect and Head of Clinical & Safety Platforms
bio: Narayanan heads the clinical and safety products of the TCS ADD™ platform. He works closely with multiple pharma and biotech companies to enable the adoption of digital products and solutions and transform their drug development processes and systems. Email ID : narayan.r@tcs.com

name: Narendran Sivakumar
designation: AI Advisory, Products and Platforms, Communications Media and Information Services Business Unit, TCS
bio: Naren globally leads AI Advisory, Products and Platforms for TCS’ Communications, Media and Information Services business unit. With almost 15 years of experience, he helps CXOs formulate AI strategy targeting the key priority areas of customer experience, product innovation, consumer insights and business transformation. Naren’s areas of interest include the evolution of the hyperconnected and data driven world and the impact on the communications industry. He is a Masters in Embedded Software Engineering from MDH, Sweden, and holds an MBA from Warwick Business School, UK.

name: Narmadha S
designation: Head, HR Talent Development, TCS Europe
bio: With over 18 years of experience in talent development, Narmadha has developed extensive expertise in strategy and governance within the HR landscape. Her diverse skill set encompasses program ownership, facilitation, content creation, strategic decision-making, and leadership in talent transformation for learning and development. As the head of talent development for TCS Europe, Narmadha is at the forefront of upskilling a highly diverse talent pool, aligning organisational learning initiatives with business objectives and employee growth in one of the most dynamic markets globally. Narmadha holds an MBA degree and is an accomplished author of two globally acclaimed books.

name: Natarajan Chandrasekaran
designation: Chairman, Tata Sons
bio: N. Chandrasekaran, chairman of Tata Sons since 2017 and CEO of TCS from 2009 to 2017, oversees a global corporation with revenue of more than $110 billion and businesses in steel, automotive, power, hotels, and consulting and IT services, among others. He is also a board director of India’s central bank (the Reserve Bank of India), chairman of the India Institute of Management, Lucknow, and president of the Court at the Indian Institute of Science Bengaluru.

name: Navin V. Bhise
designation: Head, Center of Excellence – Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement Apps, TCS
bio: Navin heads the Center of Excellence for Customer Engagement apps at TCS’ Microsoft Business Unit – Business Applications division where he is responsible for driving the technology thought leadership, managing consulting-led assignments with customers, developing reusable industry solutions, and spearheading competency management. Navin has more than 20 years’ experience working with Microsoft technologies. He has been working in Microsoft Dynamics technologies since 2010 and has successfully architected several implementations.

name: Navin Mithel
designation: Managing Partner, Customer Experience Transformation, TCS
bio: Navin Mithel leads the Marketing and Customer Insights Transformation practice within TCS’s Customer Experience Transformation (CXT) Strategic Offering. With a focus on transforming marketing operations to drive greater value, Navin has advised numerous Fortune 1000 clients on Digital Transformation, Design Thinking, Experience Strategy & Design, Conversational Commerce, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Customer-centric Transformation, Digital Governance, Digital Strategy, eCommerce and Digital Marketing. Prior to TCS, he was with IBM Interactive Experience (IX), and Head of Digital at both Alaska Airlines and Napster Music. He was also a founder of Ascentium Corporation, a $52 Million Interactive Agency. Navin has advised dozens of organizations including Microsoft, American Express, Henry Schein, Nationwide and Washington Mutual, among others.

name: Nidhi Srivastava
designation: Vice President and Global Head of AI.Cloud Offerings, TCS
bio: Nidhi Srivastava, Vice President and Global Head of AI.Cloud Offerings, Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) . As Vice President and Global Head of TCS’ AI.Cloud Offerings, Nidhi Srivastava guides clients on how to generate more business value and achieve productivity by capitalizing on cloud and AI. Within her current role, Nidhi is responsible for the development of new offerings and capabilities, including generative AI solutions, specialized AI tools, and strategic AI partnerships. Nidhi has over 25 years of experience developing and delivering technology consulting solutions across a range of industries. Prior to her current position, she served as TCS’ Vice President and Global Head, Google Business Unit, helping customers reimagine their business by leveraging TCS’ deep industry knowledge and business transformation experience, combined with the power of Google Cloud. Earlier roles include Vice President and Global Head, Enterprise Intelligent Automation and AI Practice, TCS, where she guided companies to transform into agile enterprises. Additionally, her background also includes work with leading banking and financial services organizations to drive their digital transformation. Nidhi, a visionary thought leader, has represented TCS in global industry and technology forums, and has been featured in leading publications, including The Wall Street Journal. Nidhi has been an advisory member with the Software Engineering Institute for CMMI for Services, a member of the International Process Research Consortium at Carnegie Mellon University, and a member of the Women’s Leadership Network with the Association of Management Consulting Firms. She also represents TCS on Google Cloud's Partner Advisory Council. She resides in Chicago, Illinois.

name: Nikhil Tevathia
bio: Nikhil Tevathia is a digital marketing consultant with core expertise in developing and executing online marketing strategies. He has worked for multiple Fortune 500 customers, helping them with a seamless SEO transformation journey that increased search visibility and ROI.

name: Niki Shah
designation: Consultant, Sustainable Banking, Finance & Investments, BFSI, TCS
bio: Niki Shah is an Associate Consultant, Sustainable Banking, Finance, and Investment, BFSI unit at TCS North America. In this role, he advises clients on decarbonization, climate governance and management, and transition to a net zero circular economy. He has 15 years of experience in sustainable development, ESG strategy development and regulatory reporting, and impact and responsible investing. Niki has served as an AmeriCorps VISTA, UN Volunteer, and on the US House Subcommittee on Africa and Global Health. He holds master’s degrees in global affairs and sustainability management from Rutgers University and Columbia University, respectively.

name: Nilesh B. Jagtap
designation: Consultant for new products and life cycle process
bio: Nilesh is a Consultant for new products and life cycle process in Manufacturing at TCS. He has diversified experience in the automotive sector, particularly in the off-highway vehicle domain. He holds a master’s degree in business studies and a bachelor’s degree in engineering from Pune University, Maharashtra, India.

name: Nilesh Patel
designation: Solutions Lead
bio: A solutions lead with TCS’ Education business unit, Nilesh has over 20 years of experience in technology consulting and advisory, sales and pre-sales, solutioning, and architecting service offerings. He has implemented a broad range of transformation initiatives in the emerging technologies space.

name: Niraj Pandita
designation: Consulting Partner, Cloud Strategy and Transformation, TCS
bio: Niraj Pandita is a Consulting Partner responsible for cloud strategy and transformation for Europe. He helps clients with cloud transformation, enterprise modernization, digital, AI, automation, enterprise applications –SAP, SaaS solutions and strategic outsourcing. Pandita has worked on multiple cloud platforms and cloud transformation projects. He has worked for global clients across banking and financial services, pharma and life sciences, consumer products, travel and transportation, and manufacturing.

name: Niraj Vyas
designation: Associate VP and Head, TCS ADD Analytics and Insights
bio: Dr. Niraj Vyas is the Assistant General Manager, Life Sciences at TCS. He has 16 years of experience in the biopharmaceutical industry, managing cardiac safety and centralized clinical monitoring operations. He has graduated in medicine from Seth GS Medical College and KEM Hospital in Mumbai. He also has a PG diploma in clinical research from Bombay College of Pharmacy and a Masters in Business Administration from Indira Gandhi National University.

name: Niren Moharir
designation: Product Owner, TCS HOBS™, TCS
bio: Niren Moharir has three decades of Industry experience providing IT and consulting services to telecom and affiliated industries. He currently heads the TCS HOBS platform with a focus on delivering current and competent platform-based solutions across Subscription, Device, and Data domains.

name: Nirmal Kumar J
designation: Solution architect, BFSI
bio: Nirmal Kumar J. is a solutions architect with TCS’ Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit. His areas of expertise include cybersecurity and cyber insurance and designing solutions using emerging technologies for the insurance industry. He has been with TCS for over 19 years with specialization in BPM solutions for insurance and has been part of a transformation program for a leading insurer.

name: Nishant Gupta
designation: Consulting Partner, Consumer Business Group – India Middle East and Africa, TCS
bio: Nishant Gupta is an experienced consulting professional and former entrepreneur passionate about building new businesses, solving critical business problems, customer experience, and supply chains. He leads the Global Consulting Practice GTM at TCS for India, Middle East, and Africa. Over the last 25 years, he was one of the first few to venture out with D2C, a farm-to-fridge dairy e-commerce brand and has professional experience working with leading organizations. His experience spans the areas of customer experience, market entry, go to market, key account management, sales and distribution, after sales service, supply chain, last mile logistics, D2C, and digital transformations within sectors such as dairy, FMCG, consumer durables, hospitality, retail and e-commerce. He has also been recognized as one of the top 25 retail and CPG consulting leaders in 2022.

name: Nishant Kumar
designation: Consulting Partner, Industry Advisory Group, Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance, TCS
bio: Nishant Kumar is a Domain Consultant in the Risk Management group within the Banking and Financial Services (BFS) business unit at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). He has 14 years of experience spanning areas like trading, risk management, and settlement for capital market products. Nishant is a risk management consultant and solution architect for TCS leading clients, and helps them conceptualize advanced platforms including real-time integrated risk management system for multiple asset classes, trade repository for OTC derivatives, portfolio compression, and so on. He holds a Masters degree in International Banking and Finance from the University of Strathclyde, UK, and a Bachelors degree in Electronics Engineering from Mumbai University, India. Nishant is also a Level 2 aspirant of the Financial Risk Manager Exam, Global Association of Risk Professionals (GARP), USA.

name: Nita Sarang
designation: Principal Innovation Evangelist, TCS
bio: Nita Sarangis a Principal Innovation Evangelist at TCS. She heads the Insights and Foresight function. Her primary responsibility includes ongoing secondary research and technology watch to curate a contextual trends database, prioritizing the list of top 100 technologies that drive TCS Research’s agenda. She has over 34 years of experience and holds a doctorate in Computer Science from the University of Mumbai, and a master’s degree in Electrical Engineering from The University of Notre Dame, USA.

name: Nitendra Panwar
designation: Lead Solution Architect
bio: Nitendra Panwar is the lead solution architect and delivery manager for IP-led solutions within the Research and Innovation (R&I) Incubation program at TCS. His responsibilities include designing solutions, coaching and mentoring cross domain teams and driving the agile delivery of IP led MVP and solutions. He has over 24 years of experience in design, implementation, and operational management of IT solutions across transportation in public and private sector organizations.

name: Nitesh Solanki
designation: Supply chain consultant, Manufacturing, TCS
bio: Nitesh Solanki is a supply chain consultant with TCS’ Manufacturing business unit. He plays a key role in driving thought leadership for TCS’ engagements through consulting, innovative solutions, and service transformation. Nitesh has over 17 years of experience in IT consulting and developing supply chain planning solutions. He holds a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Kharagpur, India, and a Master’s in Business Administration in Operations and Systems from the Indian Institute of Management (IIM), Kozhikode, India.

name: Nithin Thomas
designation: Consulting partner, Smart mobility
bio: Nithin is a digital transformation consultant with more than 16 years of experience in the automotive industry, leading engagements in business analytics, marketing, product management, business development, and strategy. His areas of expertise include leveraging data driven innovation as an enabler to create new business models in the context of connected vehicles and mobility ecosystems. Nithin holds a bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering from the National Institute of Technology, Calicut, India, and an MBA from the Indian School of Business, Hyderabad, India. He is an avid reader and occasional writer with a penchant for storytelling

name: Nitin Gupta
bio: Nitin Gupta is a part of the Life Sciences’ Chief Technology Officer’s group at TCS. In his current role, he facilitates innovation within Life Sciences. He has experience in areas such as machine learning, IoT, 3D printing, and social and digital marketing, with an in-depth understanding of evolving trends. He has published several thought leadership papers, blogs, and use cases in reputed national and international publications. He holds a bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering from Aligarh Muslim University, Uttar Pradesh, India, and an MBA in Marketing from Lal Bahadur Shastri Institute of Management, Delhi, India.

name: Nitin Hanjankar
designation: Head, Presales, Marketing and Alliances, Incubation, TCS
bio: Nitin Hanjankar is the Presales, Marketing and Alliances Head for TCS Incubation with over three decades of industry experience. His presales responsibilities cover incubation programs, such as drones and AI vision, industry operations, cognitive transformation, Rapid Labs, and AI performance and trust management. Nitin holds a master’s degree in Technology from Birla Institute of Technology and Science (BITS), Pilani, and a bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering from Veermata Jijabai Technological Institute (VJTI) in Mumbai.

name: Nivea Benny
bio: Nivea Benny is a Technical Lead in the Platform Solutions unit at TCS. With over 7 years in TCS, she has worked with national and international clients to provide solutions in Business Intelligence. She holds a bachelor’s degree in engineering from Calicut University, Kerala.

name: Omar Sharif
designation: Consulting Partner, Manufacturing, TCS
bio: Omar Sharif is a Consulting Partner for Manufacturing and Utilities, TCS. With a specialization in creating value from data, he has extensive experience in analytics strategy, digital transformation, data science, AI/ML, product innovation, and data monetization. Omar has helped customers in manufacturing and utilities become insights-driven organizations.

name: Palash Agarwal
designation: Global Strategy Consultant, Education Business Unit
bio: Palash is a growth advisor and strategic thinker. He has more than six years of experience across education and public services. He has served several education sector clients (EdTech companies and higher education institutions) across North America, UK, Australia & New Zealand. Palash is a strong proponent of usage of data and advance technologies in transforming learner experience and learning outcomes.

name: Pallab Datta
designation: Head, TCS Pace™, Canada
bio: Pallab is a technology enthusiast, innovator, and seasoned business leader with two decades of experience in software consultancy, design, and delivery. An engineer at his core, Pallab has persistently demonstrated his expertise in crafting innovative solutions that push the boundaries of what is possible in the digital landscape. As an innovation leader, he has successfully spearheaded numerous projects, leveraging a deep understanding of technology niches to deliver transformative solutions that align with business outcomes and drive significant value for enterprises and end-users. Pallab thrives on the excitement of exploring uncharted territory and has a passion for pushing boundaries and discovering the art of what is possible. Through active participation in research and working with technologies like Artificial Intelligence, Blockchain, and IoT, he consistently enables the delivery of innovative and impactful solutions to complex challenges. Pallab has worked with major industry verticals, including financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, travel, and retail. He has been instrumental in leading major technology transformation programs in North America, the UK, Italy, Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan, and India. Before moving to Canada in 2022, he led the implementation of PSD2 and Open Banking for a major retail bank in the UK. He has been with Tata Consultancy Services for almost 12 years. Outside of work, Pallab loves to spend quality time with his family and takes great joy in watching his two children grow up and flourish. He is also an avid soccer enthusiast.

name: Pallava Srinath
designation: Senior Consultant, Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance unit, TCS
bio: Pallava Srinath is a Senior Consultant with TCS Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance unit. With 22 years of experience in the sector, Pallava is a trend seeker―observing technology and business for trends that can help transform the retail banking operations of the clients. Pallava holds an MBA degree from Osmania University.

name: Paresh Jain
designation: Senior Domain Consultant, TCS HOBS™
bio: Paresh is a senior domain consultant and heads the network operations platform within TCS HOBS™. He is responsible for defining the product strategy for telco operations. His areas of expertise and interests include service and network orchestration and IoT device management. Paresh has a Master of Engineering degree in Systems and Information from BITS, Pilani, India.

name: Parijat Deshpande
designation: Senior Scientist, TCS Research
bio: Parijat Deshpande is a Senior Scientist with Physical Sciences at TCS Research. During his 26 years combined service with the National University of Singapore and TCS Research, he has primarily worked in the field of sensing, signal-processing and data analytics for various applications such as defence, healthcare and food research.

name: Parthasarathi V
designation: Consultant, Innovation, CTO Group, TCS
bio: Parthasarathi V is an innovation consultant with TCS’ CTO R&I group. He has been associated with TCS for the last 17 years. As a lead in the research and innovation team, his role involves identifying new market opportunities based on TCS intellectual property, along with TCS COIN™ network capabilities. He regularly contributes to tech-focused newsletters and podcasts on innovation. He is also the author of The Unbearable Lightness of the Metaverse, which was published on the Tata Group website.

name: Parthiv Shah
designation: Global Managing Partner, Cloud Strategy and Transformation, TCS
bio: Parthiv heads the Cloud Strategy Consulting & Services Integration business at TCS. He has over 25 years of experience helping Fortune 500 companies drive global complex multi-tower business transformation initiatives.

name: Parul Dua
designation: IT Analyst, TCS ADD™
bio: Parul Dua is working as a Technical Lead for TCS ADD Platform with the Life Sciences unit at TCS. In her career spanning over 4 years, she has experience in application development with hands-on experience in analytical dashboards. She holds a master’s degree in Computer Application from SASTRA University. Her areas of interest include web designing, data analytics, and machine learning.

name: Penu Putta
designation: Head - Digital Insurance Solutions, Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance, TCS
bio: Penu Putta heads digital insurance solutions in TCS’ Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit. He is also a certified Chartered Property and Casualty Underwriter (CPCU®) from the American Insurance Institute. Putta comes with over two decades of deep insurance experience and has been contributing to the growth of TCS’ insurance practice across the globe. He has played key leadership roles across sales, P&L management, delivery, and account management. Putta’s passions include leveraging new technologies such as IoT, quantum computing, AI, and ML to solve key insurance industry problems.

name: Peter Kibby
designation: Head – Transformation Practices for Utilities and Manufacturing, TCS
bio: Peter Kibby is a Solution Architect and Agile Project Manager with TCS. He has extensive experience as an information and data specialist. He has been working with businesses in the field of life sciences, utilities, government, and media since 1983.

name: Prabhakaran Pitchandi
designation: Global Head, Analytics and Insights - BFSI, TCS
bio: Prab Pitchandi is the Vice President and Global Head of the Analytics and Insights unit within TCS’ Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit. He has over 25 years of experience in the BFSI space. In his current role, he works with financial services institutions to enable them to become data-driven organizations, create an automated and contextual data foundation, and derive value from data assets.

name: Piyush Kothari
designation: Supply Chain Consultant, TCS
bio: Piyush Kothari works as a Supply Chain Consultant with TCS' Consulting and Systems Integration Practice. He has over 11 years of diversified cross industry experience covering retail, CPG, telecom, life sciences, oil and gas, and manufacturing, in supply chain design, supply chain planning, and IT solution development.

name: Piyush Srivastava
designation: Partner and Head, BFSI Industry Advisory Group, North America, TCS
bio: Piyush is a senior capital markets professional and risk management expert with TCS’ Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit. Over the past several years, Piyush has helped many clients with transformation projects that transcend capital market business processes, risk, compliance, and digital transformation. Prior to joining TCS, he has held leadership roles at various multinational companies. Piyush holds an MS in Financial Markets and Trading from Illinois Institute of Technology, Chicago, and an MBA (Marketing) and BS (Physics) from the University of Pune, India.

name: Ponmeena Shankar Kannan Kanagaraj
designation: Engagement Manager, Banking, Financial Services and Insurance, TCS
bio: Ponmeena Shankar Kannan Kanagaraj is a Senior Engagement Manager for TCS’ leading banking and financial services client in the UK. He has nearly 15 years of IT experience with special focus on business transformation for the BFSI clients leveraging the TCS Business 4.0 framework. Ponmeena Shankar holds a bachelor’s degree in Production Engineering from PSG College of Technology, Coimbatore, India.

name: Pooja Khosla
designation: PhD, Chief Innovation Officer, Entelligent
bio: Pooja Khosla is a data scientist and econometrician with extensive experience in finance. She is an inventor of Entelligent’s patented Smart Climate® technology. She has a B.S. in Economics and Mathematics and an M.S. in Econometrics and Quantitative Economics from the University of Rajasthan, and an M.S. and Ph.D. in Economics from the University of Colorado, Boulder.

name: Pooja Ranjan
bio: Pooja Ranjan leads business development for Internet of Things at TCS. She has 17 years of experience across digital transformation consulting, cross-functional areas of sales and marketing, supply chain and innovation management. Pooja has worked across industries on multiple programs at the intersection of business and digital technologies such as IoT, advanced analytics, automation and mobility.

name: Prabhakar Ravishankar
designation: Domain consultant, Industrial and Automotive Manufacturing, Manufacturing, TCS
bio: Prabhakar is a senior domain consultant in the manufacturing industry solution unit at TCS. He has over 21 years of experience in sales, service, parts, warranty, and supply chain management across the manufacturing and IT industry with a focus on process improvement and cost-reduction activities. He has been involved in multiple business process consulting assignments for many global customers in the manufacturing domain. He holds a master’s degree in computer science and engineering from the Jawaharlal Nehru National College of Engineering, Karnataka, India, and an MBA in international marketing from the Symbiosis Institute of Management Studies, Maharashtra, India.

name: Prabhu Patruni
designation: Head - Digital Thread Solutions, IOT DE, TCS
bio: Prabhu Patruni is the head for Digital Thread Solutions, part of the Internet of Things and Digital Engineering business unit at Tata Consultancy Services. He is responsible for creating digital thread solutions and services to transform global manufacturing clients in their next-generation product life cycle management (PLM) transformation journey. Prabhu has extensive experience in advising customers with PLM and digital thread business case and roadmapping, process blue printing, systems integration, and agile-driven global deployments. He is a regular speaker at PLM events hosted by leading companies.

name: Pradeep Rao
designation: Product Manager, TCS Financial Solution (TCS BaNCS)
bio: Pradeep Rao has 26 years of experience in retail banking and treasury and capital markets across the banking and software industries. He has handled multiple transformation projects, including the implementation of TCS BaNCS for Corporate Actions. He has been leading the product management function for 12 years.

name: Pradeep Singh
designation: Delivery & Operations Head of the Higher Education segment, TCS iON
bio: Pradeep Singh is the Delivery & Operations Head of the Higher Education segment at TCS iON, working closely with customer and cross-functional teams to create superior customer experience. In more than 20 years, Pradeep has worked across delivery, consulting and product streams for education, banking, and healthcare domains. He was instrumental in conceptualizing some of the top grosser learning products and managed large teams for transformation programs with a focus on innovation and teamwork. A business consultant by nature, Pradeep has led more than 20 assignments with consistently high CSS. Pradeep has done his B-Tech from IIT Kanpur and MBA from Rotterdam School of Management, the Netherlands. In his spare time, he likes to watch movies, read books, and listen to Hindi music.

name: Pradipta Chakraborty
designation: Principal Innovation Evangelist, TCS
bio: Pradipta is a principal innovation evangelist at TCS. His role involves strategic planning and synthesizing strategic insights and contextual intelligence for TCS. He holds an engineering degree in computer science and has completed a postgraduate program in general management at the Indian Institute of Management, Calcutta.

name: Pramath Jha
designation: Industry Advisor, CTO office, Communications, Media & Information Services
bio: Pramath Jha is a Distinguished Architect and an Industry Advisor in the CTO Office of Communications Media and Information services business. He has over 30 years of experience and has led architecture, design and implementation of infrastructure and network transformation programs for several Communications Service Providers across geographies. He has worked on several large-scale enterprise transformation programs focused on innovation in the areas of networks and cloud.

name: Pramod Mirji
designation: Functional Consultant, TCS
bio: He has held diverse roles in projects spanning oil and gas, petrochemicals and chemicals, industrial, power, and infrastructure sectors, contributing to global markets. Pramod is a prolific author on EPC and related topics and has served as a speaker at numerous conferences. He is a Fellow and Chartered Mechanical Engineer of the Institution of Engineers and a certified Google Cloud digital leader. He holds a master’s degree in business administration and management from the SP Jain Institute of Management and Research, Mumbai.

name: Pranava Balakrishnan
designation: Director, Lending Services at Credit Suisse
bio: Akhilesh is a chief architect in TCS’ Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit. He has over 25 years of experience in developing and designing large data intensive platforms for BFSI clients and leading teams in large organizations and managing enterprise portfolios. His focus areas include using OpenShift, Docker, Kubernetes and Odyssey Jenkins DevOps technologies to modernize legacy products for a cloud-ready data platform.

name: Pranav Shroti
designation: Solution Architect, Center of Excellence for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement Apps and Power Platform, TCS
bio: Pranav is a solution architect at the Center of Excellence for Customer Engagement apps and Power Platform in the Microsoft Business Unit – Business Applications division. He has over 17 years of experience and is currently focused on architecting complex Microsoft Dynamics implementations, and solutioning reusable industry offerings. He actively contributes to Microsoft communities by authoring blogs and publishing reusable components. He is also a distinguished speaker at several Dynamics 365 events.

name: Prasad Badkas
designation: Supply Chain Consultant, TCS
bio: Prasad Badkas is a Senior Business Consultant for supply chain in Manufacturing at TCS. He has over 21 years of experience working with global customers from different business domains such as telecom, banking, healthcare, manufacturing, and more and across functions such as supply chain, customer experience, and IT. The customers he has worked with are predominantly from North America, the UK, and Europe. He has been associated with multiple transformation projects in diverse roles such as systems designer, solution architect, domain consultant, and program manager. In his current role, he helps customers fine-tune their supply chain strategies to envision their business transformation roadmap on emerging technologies by leveraging strategy frameworks, tools, design-thinking workshops, and ideathon or hackathon events.

name: Prasanna Iyengar
designation: Consulting Partner, Retail Supply Chain, TCS
bio: Prasanna Iyengar is an industry advisor with the Retail Strategic Initiatives (RSI) arm of the Retail Business Group, TCS. Prasanna has over 20 years of experience in strategic initiatives for leading global retailers. He has delivered multi-million-dollar benefits in his engagements spanning the entire value chain across merchandising, replenishment, order management, logistics, supply chain, sourcing, and omni channel enablement. Prasanna has a master's degree in operations research from a premier Scottish University, with a bachelor’s in production engineering. His professional experience spans multiple domains of finance, manufacturing, and retail. He has also been instrumental in shaping the key supply chain offerings portfolio. Additionally, he is a regular contributor to TCS innovation and thought leadership forums as well as solutioning of value propositions for TCS customers.

name: Prasanna Krishnan Venkatesa
designation: Senior consultant, Communications, Media, and Information Services, TCS
bio: Prasanna Krishnan Venkatesa is a senior consultant with TCS’ Communications, Media, and Information Services business unit. He has over 23 years of experience working across industries to bring innovation to the forefront. He specializes in applying next-gen technologies to resolve business challenges. Prasanna is a published author, a voracious reader, and movie buff.

name: Prasenjit Das
designation: Lead, Grid edge initiative, Manufacturing and Utilities CTO group
bio: Prasenjit Das leads the grid edge initiative within the Manufacturing and Utilities CTO group at TCS. He has an extensive experience of more than two decades in the software industry. In his current role, Prasenjit leads a team comprising of senior scientists and data engineers who are building offerings in the asset, network and trading domains of renewable energy with the help of advanced digital technologies such as artificial intelligence and machine learning.

name: Prashant Chouhan
bio: Prashant Chouhan heads the New Product Innovation and Lifecycle Process business practice for the Europe Manufacturing Innovation and Transformation Group (ITG) within TCS’ Manufacturing business unit. He has 17 years of experience and has worked on business consulting and advisory services in the area of PLM and master data management for global manufacturing customers. He holds a Master’s degree in Manufacturing Management from the Indian Institute of Management – Calcutta, India, and a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering from MBM Engineering College, Jodhpur, India.

name: Prashant Deo
designation: CTO and Global Head of Security Tools and Engineering, Cyber Security
bio: Prashant Deo is the chief technology officer (CTO) in TCS’ Cybersecurity unit, where he heads the Global Security Tools and Engineering function for Cybersecurity. He has close to 25 years of experience primarily in security management and architecture consulting; security technology engineering; cyber defense operations; cybersecurity sales, solution, and business development; and cybersecurity research and innovation.

name: Pratik Kayal
bio: Pratik Kayal is a developer and team member of the Innovation and Product Engineering - Analytics (IPE - Analytics) group within TCS Platform Solutions. He possesses strong skills in Python, Data Science, Machine Learning and Deep Learning. He is responsible for multiple product engineering and innovations, working as a business intelligence and machine learning engineer. He has been contributing to the development of embedded analytics and also in implementation and hosting of Web Services for predictive analytics use cases in the home grown HRMS and Procurement platforms of TCS Platform Solutions. He holds a bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering from Academy of Technology under Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology (Formerly known as West Bengal University of Technology).

name: Praveen Bhasin
designation: Partner, M&A Services, TCS
bio: Praveen is a senior leader in TCS’ M&A Services, bringing 20 years of progressive IT and business leadership experience, along with demonstrated success driving multi-million-dollar M&A and Digital Transformation programs. Specializing in IT cost takeout and transparency during M&A, he engages with senior management teams to develop IT strategy, design operational transformation, and manage technology risk. He demonstrates a keen focus on people development and process improvement with an inclusivity and diversity approach, while planning and delivering enterprise-wide initiatives, producing significant cost savings, and improving customer experience.

name: Praveen Gauravaram
designation: Senior Scientist, TCS Australia & New Zealand
bio: Dr Praveen Gauravaram is a Consultant Senior Scientist for TCS Australia and NZ and primarily leads and manages TCS’s Co-Innovation partnership with the Cyber Security Cooperative Research Centre (CSCRC), driving the development of cutting-edge security solutions for business problems on behalf of TCS CTO office. Boasting exceptional cybersecurity R&I expertise, Dr Gauravaram has successfully navigated academia and industry, demonstrating dynamic leadership and visionary team management. As a forward-thinking cybersecurity professional with a proven track record in cutting-edge R&I and strategic consultancy for TCS, Dr Gauravaram has consistently shaped thought leadership, fortified client trust, and elevated organisational resilience by actively collaborating with stakeholders across the spectrum. Recognising Dr Gauravaram’s achievements, expertise, and leadership, Deakin University and the University of New South Wales appointed him as Adjunct Professor and Adjunct Associate Professor, respectively. Additionally, Southern Cross University has invited him to serve as an ICT Curriculum Advisory Group member.

name: Pravesh Bhargava
designation: Business Consultant, S&S Unit
bio: Pravesh is a finance consultant in the software and services segment. He is a qualified Charted Accountant from ICAI, India, with 15 years of experience in corporate FP&A and pricing. He works closely with the CFO office of TCS clients and has a track record of transforming the function by establishing new digital capabilities to unlock trapped value.

name: Priya Varadan
bio: Priya Varadan is a domain consultant in the Manufacturing Business Practice at Tata Consultancy Services. She has over 18 years of work experience straddling different functions such as research and development, pre-sales, innovation evangelism, and marketing. She has a management degree from the Indian School of Business, Hyderabad.

name: Prudhvi Kumar V
designation: Assistant Consultant, Manufacturing, TCS
bio: Prudhvi Kumar V is an assistant consultant with TCS’ Manufacturing business unit. He has over seven years of experience working with TCS’ customers in designing transformative solutions for supply chain management. He has worked on multiple projects for global enterprises from both discrete and continuous manufacturing. He holds a Master’s degree in supply chain and operations from NITIE, Mumbai, India and a Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering from the NIT, Jalandhar, India.

name: PVS Jyotsna
designation: Solution Architect, Transformation and Engineering Group, Healthcare, TCS
bio: PVS Jyotsna has over 15 years of experience in databases/data warehouses designing and implementation, among others. She also has experience in Agile delivery frameworks and is a TCS-certified Agile Ninja Coach. She has delivery experience on Scrum and SAFe delivery frameworks. Backed by her domain experience in CRM, telecom, and healthcare, she is a Solution Architect with the Transformation and Engineering Group of the Healthcare Industry Solutions Unit.

name: Radhakant Das
bio: Radhakant Das is the global head of Telecom Network Operation and Wireless Network practice of TCS' Communications, Media and Information Services business unit. He has over two decades of global experience with various telecom service providers and product companies. Das co-owns several patents in the area of virtual telephony and messaging services. His areas of expertise include cognitive automation and application of artificial intelligence in telecom networks. Das is a senior member of the Institute of Electronics and Telecommunications Engineers (IETE).

name: Raghavasuresh Samudrala
designation: Industry Solution Advisor, Banking and Financial Services, TCS
bio: Raghavasuresh Samudrala is an Industry Solution Advisor with the Banking and Financial Services unit at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). He has around 20 years of experience in IT solutions and consulting, and his areas of interest include enterprise architecture and innovation. Samudrala holds a Masters degree in Computer Science from the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Chennai, India.

name: Raghavendra Kanchan
designation: Domain Consultant BFSI
bio: Raghavendra Kanchan is a domain consultant in the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance business unit at TCS. He has over 21 years of experience predominately in the insurance domain with expertise in finance and accounting.

name: Raghunandan H
bio: Raghunandan is a Consulting Partner with TCS Life Sciences Advisory. He is a business and IT consulting professional with over 20 years of experience in both global life sciences and IT industries. He has been responsible for business-aligned IT advisory, digital solutions, thought leadership, innovations, and consulting assignments in areas of life sciences sales, marketing, patient centricity, customer relationship management, multichannel marketing, managed care, HCP engagement, ethics and compliance, and more. A postgraduate in management, Raghunandan specializes in marketing with a special focus on biotechnology.

name: Raghvendra Singh
designation: Global Head, Cloud Security
bio: With nearly 13 years of industry experience, Raghvendra has deep expertise in cybersecurity consulting, solution architecture, technology engineering and delivery oversight. In his current role, he is helping enterprises across the globe in securely transforming their IT to cloud. He holds a Bachelor of Engineering in Electronics and Communication, also certified in CISSP, CCSK, ITIL, Google professional Security engg, Azure Security Engg, Microsoft Certified 365 administrator, AWS Certified Solution Architect and Certified Ethical Hacker.

name: Rahul Agarwal
bio: Rahul Agarwal is a Domain Consultant with the Analytics and Insights R&D team in TCS Business Process Services (BPS) unit. He has more than five years of experience and is responsible for conceptualizing and developing text analytics solutions for various social media platforms. He holds an MBA degree from the Great Lakes Institute of Management, Chennai, India.

name: Rahul Gandhi
bio: Rahul Gandhi is a Consulting Partner with the Banking and Financial Services (BFS) business unit at TCS. A qualified Chartered Accountant, he has over 20 years of industry experience, especially in banking and financial services. Currently, he is the LATAM Geography lead for Finance Strategic Initiatives as well as SME on IFRS 17 Offering.

name: Rahul Ghodeswar
bio: Rahul Ghodeswar is a lead solution architect for TCS MasterCraft™ DataPlus product at TCS. He is helping TCS customers to implement data privacy solutions using DataPlus product. He has over 17 years of experience cutting across product engineering, product deployment, and data privacy consulting in multiple industry domains and geographies. He has co-authored two patents on data masking algorithms.

name: Rahul Mylapally
designation: Business Analyst, Manufacturing, TCS
bio: Rahil Mylapally is a business analyst with TCS’ Manufacturing business unit. He has over seven years of experience in providing business and IT consulting services for Fortune 500 customers. His areas of expertise include business and industry analysis, process transformation, supply chain management, and data analytics. Rahul holds a Master’s degree in supply chain management from the National Institute of Industrial Engineering (NITIE), Mumbai, India.

name: Rajagopal Yajamanam
bio: Raj evangelizes IOT technologies to enable digital transformation and operational excellence for TCS’ customers. He has extensive experience in manufacturing, supply chain, engineering and industrial services with deep understanding of IOT, industrial internet and digital twins. Raj with his team has helped many organizations in creating smart products, services, and solutions to harness new business models, bring in operational excellence and additional revenue streams.

name: Rajaram Ramakrishnan
designation: Senior consultant, CMI, TCS
bio: Rajaram Ramakrishnan is a seasoned consultant in the broadcast business and technology space. Before joining TCS, he managed ad revenue in various radio and television networks. He has more than 17 years of experience across multiple disciplines like business analysis, pre-sales and solutioning, engagement management, transition management, and consulting, and supporting customers to focus on their core business.

name: Rajaravisankar Shanmugam
bio: Rajaravisankar Shanmugam (Raja Shan), is the Global Head - Business Development for the Internet of Things (IoT) Business at TCS. He is responsible for developing the IoT Business, thus leading the global IoT Sales, Marketing & Analyst Relations, and developing strategic Alliances & partnerships. He is a leading voice in Internet of things space, delivering the keynote address at prominent industry events and has published various works of thought leadership including an article on realizing business value from Internet of things.

name: Rajat Bindlish
bio: Rajat Bindlish has over 14 years of experience, working for multiple telecom tower companies worldwide. Currently, he is working as a domain consultant and solution architect for telecom tower customers of TCS. Rajat is certified in Oracle Business Intelligence (OBIEE), Microsoft Azure cloud and Prince2 for project management.

name: Rajesh Kannan
designation: Senior consultant–Cloud Consulting and Value Advisory, AWS business unit, TCS
bio: Rajesh Kannan is a senior consultant for Cloud Consulting and Value Advisory at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). He is currently with the Cloud Consulting and Value Advisory practice of TCS’ AWS business unit. Rajesh has 20 years of IT experience. He is specialized in technology solutions, agile, release, and delivery management. In his current role, he is responsible for helping TCS’ customers from across industries and from across the world with consulting and solutioning of DevSecOps, cloud value realization, and cloud transformation initiatives.

name: Rajesh Ramar
designation: Industry Advisor, TCS, BFSI
bio: Rajesh Ramar is an industry advisor with the Banking, Financial Services and Insurance (BFSI) unit at TCS. He leads the lending industry advisory group and works with global banks to help them define, plan, and achieve their growth, transformation, and sustainability objectives. He has about 24 years of experience in delivering client specific advisory engagements and solutions, providing thought leadership, developing solutions and assets leveraging emerging technologies, and building organization-wide capabilities in the lending domain.

name: Rajesh Srinivasan
bio: Rajesh heads sales, solution, and product engineering for enterprise cloud at TCS. He brings over 25 years of experience in enterprise architecture, IT governance and transformation. In his current role, he is responsible for cloud business and transformation strategy which includes long-term technology and engineering objectives, setting-up cloud availability zones across the globe and enabling TCS’ clients across industries in their cloud journey to gain competitive edge. He has deep expertise in a variety of technologies and extensive experience in managing multifaceted partner ecosystems globally across domains.

name: Rajesh Tekchandani
designation: HR Consultant, TCS
bio: Rajesh Tekchandani is a Workforce Analytics Consultant and Human Resources SME with the Data and Analytics unit. He has been a career HR professional with 14 years of experience including global experience in APAC (Singapore) and spread across all sub-functions including talent engagement, workforce mobility, and recruitment. He has also had a stint with TCS Corporate and has been instrumental in rolling out numerous HR digitization modules and process improvements. Recently, he has been certified as Data Excellence Assessor by Tata Business Excellence Group and Data Model Builder L2 by Anaplan Inc.

name: Rajeswari Sitaraman
bio: Rajeswari Sitaraman, Head, Retail COIN Ecosystem is responsible for driving innovation for the Retail Business group of TCS. With a master’s degree in Information Systems from BITS Pilani, she has more than 19 years of retail and technology experience working with global retailers across various roles. In her previous role, she established the Retail Research Desk and was responsible for driving thought leadership marketing initiatives.

name: Rajiv Thanawala
designation: Principal Innovation Evangelist, TCS Research
bio: Rajiv is a principal innovation evangelist for sustainability in TCS Research. His 33 years of IT experience is spread across software development and delivery management. He has set up and led centers of excellence and has been involved with finding the market for new research initiatives. He holds a master’s degree in computer sciences from Ball State University, Indiana, USA. He is passionate about photography and poetry.

name: Raj Kumar Kundu
designation: Global Solution Lead, Education Unit, TCS
bio: Raj is a global solution lead in the Education Unit at TCS. He has more than 21 years of remarkable experience in technology implementation and consulting, catering to the needs of higher education and edtech customers. Raj has been an active part of major digital transformations in multiple client organizations, liaising with stakeholders at a technical and executive level.

name: Rajnish V Palande
designation: Head – Google Cloud, Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance, TCS
bio: Rajnish V Palande is the Vice President and Business Head of the Google Cloud group in TCS’ Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit. Focused on increasing agility and enabling holistic modernization of financial services organizations through leveraging cloud capabilities, Rajnish has been instrumental in driving growth and transformation programs for TCS’ financial services clients. With over two decades of experience in IT and the BFSI domain, Rajnish is an expert in strategy, leadership, business consulting, transformation, planning, and executive relationships.

name: Rakesh Devpura
bio: Rakesh Devpura leads large conglomerate and diversified industries business unit at TCS. In this role, Rakesh is managing customer relationship and driving purpose-led business growth and transformation. With more than 23 years of technology and industry experience in manufacturing and financials, Rakesh believes in driving business outcome and innovative business model with strong digital core. His expertise involves handling complex business problems of large and diversified industries through agility, speed, innovation and digital transformation. He holds a master’s degree in mechanical engineering from Indian Institute of Technology, Delhi, India.

name: Rakesh Mishra
designation: Sales and Solutions lead - ERP on Cloud (MENA Region)
bio: Rakesh Mishra has been in multiple roles across sales, solutions, and customer deliveries for global SAP customers around Europe and the Middle East. He holds a degree in electronics engineering and a master’s in finance. He has spearheaded SAP on-cloud solution design for many global customers in retail, life science, banking, manufacturing, and other industry verticals. In his current role, he oversees a large SAP on-cloud implementation for a major retailer. He continues his quest to design innovative SAP on-cloud architectures for current and future prospective customers.

name: Rakesh Sahu
designation: Senior Business Solutions Consultant, Railway Solutions, TCS
bio: Rakesh Sahu is Senior Business Consultant in Railways Solutions with TCS' Travel & Transportation Unit. He has extensive IT experience of 25+ years in Travel & Transportation, Banking and other industries. His areas of interest include Railroads, Digital Transformation, Application Migration, Operations Research and Artificial Intelligence. He holds Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering from IIT, Roorkee and is Gold Medallist in Operations Research.

name: Ralph Geertsema
designation: Partner, Finance & Shared Services Transformation, TCS
