bio: Ralph is part of the leadership team in the Finance & Shared Services Transformation practice and an innovation thought leader in the finance domain. Prior to joining TCS, he was Digital Delivery Director at Leaseplan and Executive Director at Ernst & Young. He has 25 years of consulting and operational experience in running large-scale transformation programs in consulting firms. Ralph is also a thought leader in leveraging the latest artificial intelligence capabilities at the Global Finance Innovation practice in TCS. He is based in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

name: Ramalingeswara Rao Balla
designation: Chief architect, Manufacturing, TCS
bio: Ramalingeswara Rao Balla is a chief architect in TCS’ Manufacturing unit. He has over 24 years of experience in driving tech innovation to tackle business problems for TCS’ automotive customers. Ram has a Bachelor’s degree in computer science engineering from SRKR Engineering College, Andhra Pradesh, India. He has industry recognized certifications in the enterprise architecture space such as TOGAF 9 and Open CA Level 2.

name: Ramandeep Singh
designation: Contracts Manager, Microsoft Business Unit, TCS
bio: Ramandeep Singh is a contracts manager with the Microsoft Business Unit at TCS and primarily advises on legal, IP, and privacy-related issues. He has over 15 years of consulting experience in the IT industry, including working on technologies such as robotic process automation. He has drafted many patent applications, especially in AI, digital living, and image processing. He holds a post-graduate diploma and a Master’s in computer applications from Indira Gandhi National Open University, India, and a post-graduate LL.B. degree from Delhi University, India.

name: Ramani Balakrishnan
designation: Senior business consultant, BFSI, TCS
bio: Ramani Balakrishnan is a Senior Business Consultant in the Mortgage Practice of TCS’ Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit. With over 30 years of technology and functional experience in the residential mortgage industry, Ramani has led large-scale IT transformation programs for several TCS clients across the globe. He has designed, developed, and implemented loan origination and fulfillment systems. Ramani holds an MBA in Finance (summa cum laude) from Rutgers University, New Jersey, USA, and a master’s degree in Physics from Bharathidasan University, Tiruchirappalli, India. Ramani is certified in design thinking for growth and transformation consultancy.

name: Ramesh Subramanian
designation: Consulting Partner, Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance
bio: Ramesh is a consulting partner for customer experience in TCS’ Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit. he has over 18 years of experience in the BFSI domain and has worked across multiple geographies. His areas of expertise comprise customer experience management, digital transformation, and communication modernization using design thinking for overall experience upliftment.

name: Ramesh Srinivasan
bio: Ramesh Srinivasan leads the products and services for Data and Integration Services in TCS’ AWS business unit. He has 24 years of IT industry experience and has successfully designed and implemented complex systems for insurance, healthcare and retail companies. He specializes in building data accelerators and architecting purpose-built data solutions for large corporations.

name: Ram Rajagopalan
designation: Head, Digital Commerce Transformation, Retail, TCS
bio: Ram Rajagopalan is a managing consultant with TCS’ retail business unit. He has expertise in driving next-generation transformations for retailers globally. He has over 22 years of experience working with large retail, consumer goods, manufacturing, and logistics organizations in their business transformation programs, including digital engineering, global business services (GBS), operating model transformation, and AI and analytics initiatives. Ram has an MBA from the Indian School of Business (ISB), Hyderabad and a B.Tech. degree from IIT Madras.

name: Randall Mabie
designation: Managing Partner, M&A Services, Tata Consultancy Services
bio: Randy Mabie is the global leader of TCS’ M&A Services, applying over 25 years of professional services, enterprise software, and IT operations experience. With a focus on the business advisory discipline, Randy supports executives and leads teams in the delivery of the full value chain of strategic planning, design, and implementation of transformation programs, including TCS’ end-to-end M&A Business-in-a-Box solution for completing M&A integrations and divestitures faster and with less risk.

name: Ranganathan Sundaram
designation: Global Head, Marketing and Ecosystem Initiatives, TCS Interactive
bio: Ranganathan Sundaram is the Global Head of Marketing and Ecosystem for TCS Interactive, the digital services business of TCS. He has over 28 years of experience working in various marketing roles across a variety of functions and industries. Prior to his current role, Ranga led CMO advisory for the communications and media industry and marketing transformation and operations for TCS, which included all corporate marketing functions. He also led global marketing for the Banking and Financial Services unit for over 12 years.

name: Rashmi Bhaskar Mukherjee
designation: Lead, HR Strategy Consulting, TCS
bio: Rashmi Bhaskar Mukherjee leads TCS’ HR consulting practice. Her role lies at the intersection of human capital, technology, and innovation. Her focus is post-pandemic reset in the context of individuals, organizations, society, and its implications on the future workforce, workplace, and experiences.

name: Ravikanth Parvatam
designation: Business Development Manager, Retail, TCS
bio: Ravikanth is a Business Development Manager in the Retail unit at TCS. He has been working as a transformation leader driving future store solutions across various retailers leveraging AI/ML, IoT, and automation. With a master’s degree from IIT Madras, he has more than 23 years of retail and CPG domain experience spanning solutioning, architecture, and development. He is currently the business development manager for future stores solutions and is based in the UK.

name: Ravi Mahamuni
designation: Principal Scientist, TCS Research
bio: Dr Ravi Mahamuni is a Principal Scientist, leading design research at TCS Research. He has more than 25 years of experience across diverse fields such as technology, management, and design. He has a Ph.D. in Service Design from IIT Guwahati, an Executive MBA from Symbiosis Institute of Business Management in Pune, and a bachelor’s degree in Electronics Engineering from Shivaji University, Kolhapur, India.

name: Ravindran Subbiah
designation: Entrepreneur-in-Residence (EIR), and Head, AI Performance Management Program, TCS
bio: Ravindran Subbiah is an Entrepreneur-in-Residence (EIR) with the Operations Framework Incubation Program at TCS. His vision is to accelerate intelligent automation across the IT function and build processes that provide enterprises a way to meet the increased expectations on service delivery effectiveness. He has over 25 years of experience in operations management and service management across service-provider and end-user organizations.

name: Ravishankar Kandallu
designation: Data Scientist, Manufacturing Research and Innovation Unit, TCS
bio: Ravishankar Kandallu is a statistical modeler and data scientist within the Business Intelligence and Analytics Center of Excellence in the Manufacturing business unit at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). He has worked on analytical modeling projects in the domains of warranty analytics, forecasting, and network optimization for high-tech, manufacturing, and consumer products industries. He has a doctorate in supply chain management from the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Madras.

name: Ravishankar Poonjolai
designation: Consulting Partner, Capital Markets Industry Advisory Group, Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance, TCS
bio: Ravishankar Poonjolai is a Consulting Partner with the Industry Advisory Group within the Banking and Financial Services (BFS) business unit at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). He has more than 20 years of industry experience and has been involved in several consulting and implementation engagements for TCS' clients in the financial services sector. Poonjolai has a Bachelor's degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering from the Coimbatore Institute of Technology, Coimbatore, India, and a Master's degree in Business Administration from the Indira Gandhi National Open University (IGNOU), Delhi, India.

name: Ravi Varma
bio: Ravi Varma has over 20 years of IT industry experience and around 17 years of association with TCS and Microsoft. As Head of Talent Development in the TCS Microsoft segment, Ravi helps associates grow their career.

name: Regu Ayyaswamy
designation: Senior Vice President and Global Head, Internet of Things, TCS
bio: Reguraman (Regu) Ayyaswamy is Senior Vice President & Global Head, Internet of Things (IoT) at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). In this role, Regu lends direction to the world’s leading companies as they transform into connected digital enterprises, poised for growth in the Business 4.0 era. Regu partners with global business leaders to help them unlock new opportunities and revenue models by harnessing the combined power of IoT and emerging digital technologies. Regu also leads the Engineering & Industrial Services (EIS) business at TCS where he advises business leaders on strategy, development, process and growth management. Drawing on his extensive experience, he provides direction to companies looking to develop products that focus on local markets and developing worlds, and long-term strategies for global R&D management. Regu is passionate about bringing business and operations transformation to enterprises across industries, helping them drive top line growth through innovation and achieve bottom line improvement through efficiencies. He is an advisor to multiple global enterprises on improving their speed to market for new products, renovating their business models and overhauling their operations processes with proven impact delivered in core industries like manufacturing, utilities, transportation and retail. An acknowledged thought leader, Regu is regularly invited as a speaker to major industry events and featured in leading online publications on how IoT can be leveraged to address the challenges faced by business organizations and drive value throughout the Connected Digital Enterprise. He is also frequently quoted by major media houses in their features about shaping key digital transformation deals in the market. In addition, Regu holds a number of key responsibilities in many national and international fora, including serving as a Board member of TCS Japan Limited.; steering committee member of Engineering and R&D council of NASSCOM and member of the Governing Council for Center of Excellence for IoT set up by the Government of India with NASSCOM. Regu resides in Chennai with his wife Padma, and they have a son and daughter. Outside of work and his passion for technology, Regu is an avid reader with a drive to enrich his understanding different schools of philosophy.

name: Regu Ayyaswamy
designation: Senior Vice President & Global Head of IoT, TCS
bio: Reguraman (Regu) Ayyaswamy is Senior Vice President and Global Head of Internet of Things (IoT) and Digital Engineering at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). He is responsible for creating value-based solutions and services to enable accelerated product development and integrated manufacturing for clients across the discrete and process manufacturing industries. Regu has varied experience spanning customer relationship management, program management, competency development, and people management. In the past, he also headed the TCS Cincinnati office and was responsible for developing key relationships in the region. An acknowledged thought leader, he is regularly invited as a speaker to major industry events and forums.

name: Rekha George
designation: Banking and Financial Services, TCS
bio: Rekha George is Domain Consultant with TCS BFSI Industry Advisory Group and leads the Finance & Reporting Sub Practice. She is responsible for thought leadership in areas like financial reporting & compliance and finance transformation and anchors consulting engagements for BFSI customers

name: Rekha Natarajan
designation: Technology Head, Manufacturing and Utilities Business Group
bio: Rekha Natarajan is the Technology Head in the Manufacturing and Utilities Business Group at TCS. With over 20 years of experience, she has extensive expertise in the areas of enterprise automation, quality engineering, and artificial intelligence. Since 2019, Rekha has been associated with the automation function in the business group, focusing on the growth and transformation initiatives involving but not limited to robotic process automation, hyperautomation, and low code-no code platforms.

name: Dr. Rekha Singhal
designation: Head - TCS Research, TCS Pace Port™ New York
bio: Dr. Singhal heads TCS Research at TCS Pace Port™ New York. She has worked in both corporate and academic research. Her research interests are in the areas of high performance data analytics systems, heterogeneous architecture, performance modelling of big data systems, query optimization, and storage area networks. Rekha headed the development of the disaster recovery product Revival 1000, which was launched at the Centre for Development of Advanced Computing. She received her MTech and PhD (computer science) from IIT Delhi, India. Follow Rekha Singhal on social media

name: Reni Parameshwaran
designation: Head, Innovation, Insurance Innovation Lab, TCS
bio: Reni is a solution manager at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) Insurance Innovation Labs. He focuses on creating next generation solutions in the customer experience space. He has been instrumental in conceptualizing and creating futuristic solutions such as Mobile Telematics and Virtual Advisor. Reni has also led multiple architectural engagements for some of the largest transformation programs for prominent insurance companies.

name: Rhitwik Singh
designation: Business Development Manager, Platform Solutions, Products & Platforms, TCS Chroma™
bio: Rhitwik Singh is a Business Development Manager in TCS Platform Solutions. His area of expertise includes market research & analysis, target market identification, brand positioning and development, vendor management, and content creation and sales for AI & ML Solutions.

name: Richard Sherman
bio: Rich Sherman is an internationally recognized author and thought leader on trends and issues across supply chain management. His book Supply Chain Transformation: Practical Roadmap for Best Practice Results (Wiley, 2012) has received praise by practitioners, academics, and non-supply chain executives as a great read on business transformation. As a research director, he successfully launched the supply chain advisory services for AMR Research (now Gartner) and led in the development of the SCOR® model, founding the Supply Chain Council, and serving on its Board. He has contributed scores of articles and speaks frequently on supply chain trends and models. Rich received his BA and MA from Notre Dame.

name: Rijoy Seal
designation: Business Analyst, R & I
bio: Rijoy has been with TCS for close to a decade as a business analyst within Research and Innovation. He works in the space of emerging technologies such as NFT and Gen AI. Rijoy Seal has been with TCS for close to a decade. He is currently a business analyst within the Research and Innovation unit at TCS. He works in the space of emerging technologies such as NFT and Gen AI, and is responsible for design thinking, conducting market research, performing business analysis, and formulating use cases. Prior to his current role, Rijoy was a functional analyst specializing in the credit card domain within the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance unit at TCS. His extensive experience in this area strengthens his capability to navigate the intricacies of innovative technologies.

name: Rinkal Brahmbhatt
designation: Digital Workplace Practice – Software & Services
bio: Rinkal Brahmbhatt heads the digital workplace practice for TCS' Software and Services segment. In her current role, she provides consultation and advisory services on digital workplace services and solutions to TCS’ customers globally.

name: Rita Shah
designation: Senior Consultant, Life Sciences, TCS
bio: Rita Shah is a clinical research professional with over 21 years of experience in life sciences and pharma domain, supporting technology anchorage and innovation. She comes with R&D business process knowledge and understanding of technology to bring transformation and develop IT solutions that drive productivity, efficiency, and compliance in the life sciences’ clinical and regulatory domains. Rita is actively involved in the development of innovative conceptual solutions in R&D leveraging automation technologies. Rita holds a doctorate degree in organic chemistry, has published more than a dozen peer-reviewed articles, and has worked as a postdoctoral fellow and assistant research professor (molecular biology) at the Indiana University School of Medicine, USA.

name: Dr. Ritu Anand
designation: Chief Leadership & Diversity Office, TCS
bio: Dr. Ritu Anand is a pioneer in the field of Human Resources with a career spanning 25+ years. She is a Senior Vice President at Tata Consultancy Services and spearheads TCS' Workplace Diversity initiative and is a member of the Group Diversity Council and the HR Steering Committee at the Tata Group. Her various advisory roles include: Member of Worldwide ERC Global Advisory Council and Advisory Board member of the National HRD Network in Mumbai. She is the Governing Board Member of WILL (Forum for Women in Leadership), that aims at bringing together the collective aspirations, talents, and mentoring of women across corporate India. She is on the Board of Directors at two Tata Group companies and has a doctorate in Psychology.

name: R Murali
designation: Retail, CPG, travel group CTO, TCS
bio: Murali has been with TCS for 28 years. He has extensive experience in all four generations of technology and leads the architecture and technology for the group. Murali, who heads the group’s digital growth and transformation initiatives, helps retailers transform their landscape.

name: Robert Kane
designation: National VP, US Public Services, TCS North America
bio: Robert is the national VP of TCS’ public services business in the United States. In this capacity, he is responsible for the government affairs, market development, growth, and client services in TCS’ business spanning state and local agencies and municipalities across the US. Robert graduated from Pennsylvania State University and holds a Bachelor of Science degree in Logistics and Industrial Engineering along with an MBA in Finance from the University of Bridgeport. He joined TCS in 2006.

name: Robert Watson
designation: Engagement Director, Consulting, TCS
bio: Robert is an Engagement Director with Consulting at TCS. Previously, he served as Global Organizations Advisor and the Private Sector Threat Intel Program Manager at Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Agency (CISA) as part of Department of Homeland Security (DHS).

name: Rohit Kadam
designation: Researcher, LSHCPSER, Pharma IT Solutions & Innovation
bio: Rohit Kadam is a Researcher at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). He is working with the TCS ADDTM Life Sciences Platform as a Researcher in R&I Team for nearly 2.5 years and contributed extensively in developing key solutions for TCS Healthcare Domain. In his current position, Rohit is responsible for the creation of innovative technology solutions that make use of artificial intelligence and other cutting-edge technologies across a variety of life sciences operations.

name: Rohit Kale
bio: Rohit Kale heads Microsoft Dynamics practice within Enterprise Solutions business unit in TCS. He has over 22 years of industry experience including 21 years in TCS. Rohit has played various consulting and leadership roles such as Solution Architect, Program Manager, CoE Lead, Business Relationship Manager and Global Delivery Head. He has led many end-to-end engagements in the domain of Financial Services, Automotive, Retail and Telecommunications which include key programs for GE Capital, AutoZone, Tata Motors, Verizon, The Home Depot and Motorola. Rohit is an Engineering graduate from VJTI, Mumbai, India.

name: Rohit Patnekar
bio: Based in Amsterdam, Rohit Patnekar is a client partner for Europe Public Sector for TCS. Prior to this role, he held various leadership positions for TCS in the Netherlands and India. He holds an MBA from the Rotterdam School of Management at Erasmus University. Patnekar follows his passion for cricket by playing for the Amsterdam Cricket Club and is also a long-distance runner, and he has many times in the TCS-sponsored Amsterdam Marathon.

name: Romil Shah
designation: Research Analyst, Corporate Marketing Research, TCS
bio: Romil Shah is a Research Analyst with TCS’ Corporate Marketing Research. He has close to seven years of experience and is engaged in strategic research for transportation and hospitality. He has completed his B.E. in electronics and communication and MBA in marketing.

name: Rosanne Dawkins
designation: Head of Content for TCS Europe and UK
bio: Based in London, Rosanne is Head of Content for TCS Europe and UK. She oversees content strategy and multimedia projects across campaigns and events, as well as development of TCS' point of view and thought leadership perspectives. She is an experienced writer and content creator and has worked across a number of sectors, including IT services, arts and culture, and consulting.

name: Ruben Jacob Abraham
designation: Senior Domain Consultant, Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance, TCS
bio: Ruben Jacob Abraham is a senior domain consultant in the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance unit at TCS. With expertise in financial crime compliance, he has been an industry practitioner for over 15 years. He has extensive experience handling knowledge transformation and transition for large teams in areas of anti-money laundering (AML) and know your customer (KYC) across geographies and risk types. He holds an MBA degree in human resources and other relevant certifications in the AML and KYC domains.

name: Rupal Gupta
designation: Technical Architect, BI Analytics and Visualization
bio: Rupal is a technical architect in the Business Intelligence Analytics and Visualization CoE at TCS. She has over 16 years of experience in executing full life cycle BI data visualization solutions across industry verticals in telecom, healthcare, HR, and entertainment domains. With hands-on experience in implementing visualizations through multiple BI tools, she has developed a strong understanding of visualization design principles in dashboard and report designing, implementation, testing and performance optimization. She holds an engineering degree in Electronics Design Technology from Nagpur University.

name: Rupa Misra
bio: Rupa Misra is a Principal Innovation Evangelist at Corporate Research & Innovation (R&I), TCS. She currently drives a global and strategic program with the TCS leadership to elevate customer and stakeholder engagement through the inspirational brand and brand instantiations of TCS Pace™ and TCS Pace Port™. Rupa has been a part of the Information Technology industry for 23 years – all spent at TCS – and has essayed a variety of leadership roles across technology, business, and research and innovation. Follow Rupa Misra on LinkedIn

name: Rushikesh Tanksale
bio: Rushikesh Tanksale is associated with TAP™, which is a TCS’ source-to-pay cloud solution. He has 15 years of professional experience in transformation and service delivery, product design and development, and presales in the accounts payable and procurement domains. Rushikesh holds a master’s degree in Operations Management, and a bachelor’s degree in Metallurgical Engineering.

name: Rutuparn Paratkar
designation: Senior consultant
bio: Rutuparn Paratkar is a Senior Consultant and Business Relationship Manager at TCS. He has over 21 years of experience working with global customers across geographies in business domains of life sciences, healthcare, investment banking, finance, and corporate functions. He has led several initiatives in realizing IT strategy for his client CIOs in cloud transformation, modernizing data platforms, establishing end-to-end IT support, team building, and managing large and diverse IT portfolios in TCS. He is a Certified Agile Coach and has coached over 300+ professionals in agile by conducting "Living Agile Sessions" across various industry verticals. He lives in North Carolina, USA.

name: Sachin Deshmukh
bio: Sachin Deshmukh is a Pre-Sales & Solutions Consultant for HR Transformation with the Platform Solutions unit at TCS. He holds a master's degree in IT and Marketing from Balaji Institute of Modern Management, Pune.

name: Sachin Khalap
designation: Head of Governance, Risk and Compliance and the Data Privacy Center of Excellence
bio: Sachin Khalap heads TCS’ Governance, Risk and Compliance and Data Privacy Center of Excellence for Cybersecurity. He has more than 21 years of experience primarily in cybersecurity and governance, risk management, and compliance (GRC) with over eight years in a leadership role. His experience spans across cybersecurity consulting, compliance audits and assessments and in leading security and technology implementation projects. His skillset covers risk management, vulnerability management, attestation (SOC1 & SOC2), vendor risk management, and more.

name: Sachin Sharad Punalekar
designation: Domain Consultant, Manufacturing, TCS
bio: Sachin is a domain consultant within TCS' manufacturing business unit. He has more than two decades of experience in designing and building solutions around enterprise resource planning (ERP) Implementation and manufacturing consulting. He has worked with multiple customers and made improvements in the manufacturing processes such as supply chain and shop floor management. In his current engagement, he is working as a domain consultant for TCS’ manufacturing unit. Sachin holds a Bachelor’s degree in Electronics Engineering from the University of Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.

name: Sachin Sadashiv Deshpande
designation: Chief Architect, Banking, Financial Services and Insurance (BFSI), TCS
bio: Sachin is a chief architect in TCS’ BFSI business unit. He has over 27 years of IT experience, mainly in the BFSI domain. In his previous roles, he was part of the business intelligence practice and has also led large transformation engagements. In his current role, he leads solution development and data engineering in the analytics and insight group within TCS.

name: Sai Prashanth Billakanti
designation: Functional Consultant, Products & Platforms, TCS Chroma
bio: Sai Prashanth Billakanti is a functional consultant working in the HR domain at TCS. He is a seasoned professional with over three years of dedicated service at TCS. Sai has been a key team player and has handled multiple turnkey projects as an HCM functional consultant. Currently, Sai is working as a human resource business partner for NGM-MEA markets. He holds a PG Diploma in Human Resources. Outside the technology and HR transformation, he enjoys music, badminton, and cricket.

name: Sajeeli Goyle
designation: Domain Consultant, Healthcare, TCS
bio: Sajeeli is a healthcare domain consultant with an overall 24 years of IT experience of which, she has over 20 years of specialized domain expertise in insurance and healthcare developed by working closely with clients and users in designing new solutions and systems. Sajeeli is part of the Healthcare and MedTech CTO team focusing on innovation and helping clients on their AI and GenAI journeys. Her expertise in insurance and healthcare enables her to spot trends and identify opportunities for technology-driven transformation, the latest being composite AI. Sajeeli has an MBA in IT and has been granted patents for her healthcare inventions.

name: Salman Uddin
designation: Marketing Lead, TCS ADD Metadata Repository, TCS
bio: Salman Uddin works as a Marketing Lead for TCS ADD Metadata Repository Platform. Backed by a master’s degree in business administration, he is a dedicated marketing professional with experience in effectively delivering multi-channel marketing campaigns, content creation, SEO, and market research.

name: Sameer Rane
bio: Sameer Rane handles market analyst connect and marketing aspects of TCS MasterCraft™ DataPlus, which is a data management software from TCS. Sameer has 17 years of experience in the IT industry and has played a leading role in maintenance, deployment, and management of software products and solutions. His current areas of interest include data privacy and data quality management.

name: Sameer Shinde
designation: Head – IAM Professional Services, Cybersecurity, BFSI, TCS
bio: Sameer Shinde heads IAM Professional Services in the Cybersecurity practice of TCS’ Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit. He has over 22 years of experience in solution design and implementation as well as consulting in various areas including identity and access management (IAM), data security, and network management. Sameer plays an instrumental role in creating technical proposals and points of view to convince potential customers of TCS’ capabilities. He has also been involved in building new solutions and accelerators and managing complex IAM programs for large banks. When not working in the IAM domain, he likes to indulge his passion for photography and sketching.

name: Samuel Selvaraj
designation: Senior Strategy Consultant, PLM, EIS, TCS
bio: Samuel Selvaraj is the Digital Thread Solutions Lead with Internet of Things, Business & Technology Services. His areas of expertise include digital thread, digital transformations enabling connected digital enterprise. He has experience spanning across consulting, technical leadership of solution teams, client relationships, and management of transformational initiatives across various industry sectors such as Aerospace, Energy, and HiTech. Samuel has been with TCS for the last 21 years, and has a total industry experience of over 25 years.

name: Sandeep Banyal
designation: Principal Partner - MarTech, TCS Interactive
bio: Sandeep Banyal is a Principal Partner in the MarTech practice of TCS Interactive. He has expertise in building productized offerings, platforms and heading digital advisory practice responsible for business and technology transformations. He has been responsible for growing the business with productized offerings and creating large-scale delivery opportunities with consultative engagements. As part of his role at TCS Interactive, Sandeep assists customers in embracing their digital transformation journeys by utilizing the four archetypes of excite, advice, engage, and manage.

name: Sandeep Behera
designation: Business Analyst, Aero and Process Division, Manufacturing and Utilities Business Unit, TCS
bio: Sandeep Behera is a Business Analyst with the Connected Fleet Strategic Initiatives at TCS. With over two years of experience in the IT industry, he is responsible for marketing, business analysis, and research in the supply chain and logistics domains. He holds B.Tech and M.Tech degrees in Electrical Engineering from NIT Rourkela, and is a management graduate from NITIE, Mumbai.

name: Sandeep Meher
bio: Sandeep Meher leads the Digital Channels Solutions team for India at TCS. He has 24 years of experience in TCS, and has worked closely with its customers in India, South Africa, UK, Europe, and Hong Kong SAR, delivering business and technology solutions for digital transformation initiatives in BFSI, telecom, manufacturing, TTH and retail. Sandeep holds a bachelor's degree in Electronics Engineering from Fr. Conceicao Rodrigues College of Engineering, Mumbai.

name: Sandeep Muju
designation: Industry Advisor, Aerospace and Defense, TCS
bio: Dr Muju is a Industry Advisor in the aerospace and defense practice at TCS. He is responsible for enabling business transformation, growth, innovation, and digitalization initiatives for global clients. Sandeep has extensive experience in leading Fortune 100 aerospace and defense organizations, as well as highly engineered and manufactured products and technology services sectors. He has also been recognized as a Top 50 Global thought leader on Innovation Ecosystems by Thinkers 360.

name: Sandeep Saxena
designation: Global Head, Data Marketplace, TCS
bio: Sandeep Saxena is Program Head at TCS Research and Innovation. His current focus is on developing a data marketplace platform and a cross-domain blockchain platform using existing open frameworks. Sandeep is a TOGAF-certified architect and holds MSc (Hons) and BE (Hons) degrees from BITS Pilani.

name: Sandeep Saxena
designation: Head, Data Marketplace, Enterprise Growth Group, TCS
bio: Sandeep Saxena is the Offering Head of TCS Dexam. His current focus is on developing a data marketplace platform and a cross-domain blockchain platform using existing open frameworks.

name: Sandip Brahmachary
bio: Sandip has 21 years of rich experience in the software industry in data ecosystem which includes database, data warehousing, business intelligence, data engineering, data science, data governance and data management. He has worked in cross domain, multi-cultural and multiple technological environments in data architecture solutioning, delivery management, product engineering, and data science. Sandip has filed more than 10 patents. Currently, he is a project manager in TCS’ Communications, Media, and Information Services (CMI) business unit and looking after solutioning, designing and delivering data engineering and data science engagements along with product engineering.

name: Sandip Dutta
designation: Talent Engagement Manager
bio: Sandip is a senior HR leader with 12 years of progressive experience. He has a strong background in talent management and employee relations. Sandip is exceptionally skilled in building and executing strategies and programs to support organizational development, leadership, and performance management.

name: Sangsthita Nandy
bio: Sangsthita Nandy is a Business Relationship Manager with TCS based in Europe. A hands-on leader, she works at the intersection of banking, financial services, digital technologies, and innovation, helping institutions deliver powerful, personalized experiences. With almost 15 years of cross functional experience including marketing, business development, program management, user experience and innovation management, she has helped deliver business value to global clients across banking, financial services, life sciences and pharma industries.

name: Sanjay Fernandes
designation: ANZ Communications Head and Global Head for TCS Contexify™ CMI, TCS
bio: Sanjay Fernandes heads the Communications Segment for Australia and New Zealand, CMI, TCS and is the global head for TCS Contexify™. With over 25 years of experience in the Telecom and IT industry, he has successfully designed, implemented, and managed over 100 projects across India and Australia. He has rich expertise in business transformations, strategic planning and implementation, and relationship/customer management. He is highly passionate about delivering exceptional business outcomes through transformational and strategic initiatives.

name: Sanjay Prasad
designation: Head - Capital Markets and Wealth: US, Canada, UK&I, TCS Financial Solutions
bio: Sanjay is responsible for the GTM strategy and development of TCS BaNCS’ capital markets and wealth business in North America and UK/I. Sanjay brings over 22 years of experience in advising top global banks in their core technology modernization initiatives in the areas of asset servicing, custody, corporate actions, wealth management and private banking. Sanjay is responsible for the GTM strategy and development of TCS BaNCS’ capital markets and wealth business in North America and UK/I. Sanjay brings over 22 years of experience in advising top global banks in their core technology modernization initiatives in the areas of asset servicing, custody, corporate actions, wealth management and private banking. Sanjay is an active member and speaker at industry gatherings like SIFMA, ISITC and CorpActions UK.

name: Sankaranarayanan “Shanky” Viswanathan
designation: Vice President, Corporate Technology Office, TCS
bio: Shanky Viswanathan is a Business Leader, Industry Advisor and Technologist in the CTO Group in TCS. As Head of Business Innovation, Shanky works with CxOs to help shape their strategic business initiatives and unlock new business opportunities by harnessing the transformative, and sometimes disruptive, potential of technology. He is currently focused on helping customers prepare and build for the future by harnessing the full might of Generative AI, Operational Technology modernization, accelerate energy transition and a reimagined toolset for NetZero acceleration. Within TCS, Shanky is leading the incubation of next generation business capabilities and big bets that will power the future growth of TCS. Prior to this role, Shanky has performed various Business and Technology leadership roles across markets and Industries. He has led industry units for TCS, incubated and scaled large account relationships, spearheaded multiple large scale business transformation and system integration initiatives for customers and has headed architecture boards and functions in various customer organizations. He has been part of industry advisory boards and holds multiple patents in real-world business solutions exploiting digital technologies. A native of Chennai, India, Shanky holds a Master’s degree in Computer Science & Engineering. He is a passionate barefoot runner, a trained percussionist of Carnatic music and a movie buff.

name: Santanu Ghosh
designation: Principal Consultant, Data and Analytics, TCS
bio: Santanu leads the sustainability ecosystem practice for Analytics and Insights at TCS and is a sustainability evangelist. He brings to the table more than 27 years of industry experience. He is responsible for exploring and launching data and analytics-driven sustainability offerings for the environment, climate, health, and biodiversity as well as around ecosystems created for sustainable businesses and the resultant monetization opportunities that come with it.

name: Santanu Sur
designation: Lead Consultant, Oil and Gas, Energy and Resources, TCS
bio: Santanu has more than 35 years of experience in the Oil and Gas, Petrochemical, and IT industry. Prior to his current assignment at TCS as a domain consultant with connected worker, he had spent over two decades with India’s largest pipeline operator and a leading petrochemical company. His functional experience encompasses maintenance, marketing, operations, production and transmission of natural gas, LPG, polymers, industrial chemicals, and petrochemicals. At present, Santanu is involved in developing IT solutions as part of the connected worker and domain COE.

name: Saptarshi Das
bio: As a strategist and industry advisor, Saptarshi heads the advisory and solutions group for Information Services and New Media segment, TCS. With over 19 years of experience, he drives organizational transformation initiatives focusing on innovation, agility, and a machine-first culture. He is a domain expert in services pertaining to credit legal, publishing and the education sectors. He holds a Bachelor’s degree in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering from the Institute of Engineering and Management, Kolkata, India.

name: Sapthagiri Chapalapalli
bio: Sapthagiri “Saptha” Chapalapalli leads TCS Europe, overseeing the company’s growth and transformation across the region while collaborating with global enterprises to unlock the full potential of AI and accelerate their journey from infrastructure to intelligence. With more than 30 years of global experience across India, Europe, and North America, Saptha brings practical expertise and strategic vision. He has guided organisations through transformative journeys, modernising their cloud, data and technology foundations, strengthening cybersecurity resilience, and enabling new business models powered by AI. Central to his approach is helping enterprises harness intelligence across the full technology stack, from infrastructure and platforms to applications and business operations, enabling them to drive innovation, agility and sustainable growth at scale. He co-creates with customers to deliver measurable business outcomes, operational efficiency and long-term value through Human+AI transformation. Beyond business, Saptha is actively involved with academia, bringing industry insights to help shape the leaders of tomorrow. He serves on the advisory boards of the European School of Management and Technology (ESMT) Berlin, T.A. Pai Management Institute (TAPMI), and the Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Sirmaur in India.

name: Sarah Kingsley
designation: Director of Marketing Services, TCS Interactive, TCS
bio: Sarah Kingsley is a Sr. Director, Marketing Strategy & Services at TCS Interactive Services She has a long track record of building trusted partnerships with a diverse list of Fortune 100 clients in the apparel, CPG, health & beauty, retail, healthcare, pharmaceutical, banking, financial services and digital/technology industries. Sarah is an experienced brand marketing leader with expertise in developing sound strategy, simplifying complex challenges, championing smart creative solutions, and growing brands and businesses in a rapidly changing landscape. She is a passionate and energized leader that inspires strategic and creatively-driven work and is best known for her collaboration, innovative problem solving, resilience and open mind. Prior to joining TSC, Sarah spent 22 years in both creative and marketing agencies such as Publicis Sapient, Deutsch NY and Fallon, as well as marketing roles on the client side, recently Senior Brand and Category Marketing Manager at Target Corporation.

name: Sarah Rushforth
designation: Senior Consultant
bio: Sarah Rushforth is a consultant in TCS. She is an M&A strategy and project management professional with over 15 years of experience in project management consulting, process improvement, and change management. She has experience with Fortune 500 companies, working on pre-deal and post-close activities ranging from production rationalization, data analytics, business and IT strategy and process improvement. Sarah obtained her MBA from the Mississippi State University and graduated from the university with dual bachelorette degrees in international business and French. In her spare time, she enjoys baking and spending time with her family.

name: Sarika Madrewar
bio: Sarika Madrewar completed her undergraduate degree in Computer Science Engineering from Babasaheb Naik College of Engineering. She leads the Solutions team of the Data Transformation Edition of TCS MasterCraft TM TransformPlus, which is an intelligent automation product for defining and executing data migration from legacy to relational DB or NOSQL databases. She has more than 15 years of industry experience, and continuously contributes to building product solutions and is involved in deployment at customer-end.

name: Satadru Kundu
bio: Satadru Kundu is a Senior Developer with nine years of experience in the Innovation and Product Engineering (IPE) - Analytics group with the Platform Solutions unit at TCS. His area of expertise includes solution design, development and implementation of various AI and ML use cases for the homegrown products CHROMA TM and TAP TM . He holds a bachelor’s degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering from Netaji Subhash Engineering College, Kolkata, India.

name: Sathish Narayanan
designation: Business Analyst, BFSI
bio: Sathish is a business analyst and has over 17 years of IT experience with core expertise in capital markets and enterprise knowledge management. He has been a part of major transformation initiatives for capital market customers. His areas of interest include the application of blockchain technologies, generative AI, and digital assets in capital markets. He holds a Bachelor of Engineering degree in information technology.

name: Satishchandra Doreswamy
designation: Vice President & Global Head, TCS Enterprise Cloud
bio: Satishchandra Doreswamy, known as “Satish”, is the Vice President and Global Head of Cloud Infrastructure at TCS. In his current role, is responsible for building TCS’ Enterprise Cloud business to address the rapidly growing market demand. Satish, in his previous role, has led many TCS’ Global Business Transformations, working closely with the CEO’s office spanning across innovative products, platforms and start-ups. An industry veteran with more than 25 Years of experience, Satish has provided leadership across strategy, business management, mergers & acquisitions, sales & delivery/operations. Satish holds a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering from Bangalore University.

name: Satish Kumar Barnala
designation: Enterprise Architect, Technology, Software, and Services
bio: Satish Kumar Barnala is an enterprise architect who leads transformation and innovation initiatives for TCS' Technology, Software, and Services business unit. He holds a postgraduate degree in engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology, Madras, India. A certified data scientist, Satish is part of The Open Group Architecture Framework (TOGAF).

name: Saumabha Barua
designation: Head – Transformation Practices for Utilities and Manufacturing, TCS
bio: Saumabha leads the Transformation Practice for Energy & Resources, Utilities and Manufacturing for TCS Cognitive Business Operations unit. With 25 years of experience in building relationships with organizations from the CxO level right all the way through to operational level, bringing in both the top-down and bottoms-up view having worked in presales and solutioning, transformation and innovation, program and project management, process and technology consulting with multiple clients across the globe. Having worked in both IT and BPO, he possesses a 360-degree view of business and industry, especially in the areas of technology-led process improvement and the adoption of best practices. His current areas of work include robotics, AI/ML-led digital initiatives, and predictive analytics. Saumabha holds a bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering from Jadavpur University and a PGDM from IIM, Calcutta.

name: Saurabh Das
designation: Head, Research and Innovation, TCS ADD™ Analytics and Insights, TCS
bio: Saurabh Das is the product head and project manager at TCS ADD™ and also heads TCS ADD™ Research and Innovation. He has over 17 years of experience in product development and managing large program executions. He has multiple patents and publications in reputable journals. He's been a regular speaker at SCDM, SCOPE, and PharmaSUG.

name: Sayantan Datta
designation: Research Analyst – BFSI, Marketing Transformation Group, TCS
bio: Sayantan Datta is a research analyst in TCS’ Marketing Transformation and Operations group. He provides research based advisory services to global enterprises for digital transformation. A certified Financial Risk Management professional, Sayantan holds a Bachelors’ degree in Computer Science and Engineering from West Bengal University of Technology and an MBA from IISWBM, Kolkata, India.

name: Sayantan Santra
bio: Sayantan Santra is a Solution Architect in the Open Banking Strategic Initiative group of the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance business unit at TCS. He has over 13 years of IT experience predominately in retail banking and insurance with expertise in open banking, API banking, API security, and next-gen digital banking implementation. Sayantan is an alumnus of Jadavpur University, Kolkata, India.

name: Scott Hilchey
designation: Director, Customer Experience Transformation, C&SI
bio: As a Director of TCS’s Customer Experience Transformation (CXT) Strategic Offering, Scott works with clients to deliver effective strategies that harness customer centric models for digital transformations. Over the past 20 years, he has advised clients on Customer Experience, CRM, Marketing Operations, Sales Effectiveness, Market and Customer Strategy, Loyalty, and Customer Life-Cycle Management. Scott brings an international perspective, is a champion of innovation delivery, and has led large, diverse professional teams. Prior to TCS he was at IBM Interactive Experience, Capgemini, and Razorfish. His client work includes, among others, Astellas Pharma, Collins Aerospace, Thomson Reuters, Coca-Cola Refreshments, BMW NA, Honda NA, Subaru, and Disney.

name: Seema Chandrasekharan
designation: Senior consultant, BFSI
bio: Seema Chandrasekharan is a Senior Consultant with TCS’ Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance unit. She has over 24 years of experience in insurance, IT services, and consulting, with expertise in a wide range of architecture and solutions relevant to insurance and pension enterprises. She has performed various roles, including that of a solution architect, integration architect, digital API consultant, and designer and technical architect of large transformation programs.

name: Selvan S. S.
bio: Selvan is the business head for TCS DigiFleet TM . An engineer by education, Selvan is a seasoned technology professional. He has played multiple roles ranging from program management to front-end sales in the automotive, heavy industry and high tech sectors. Selvan has also been a keynote speaker in several public fora including transport, logistics, supply chain and technology skill building to enable Industry 4.0.

name: Senthil Chandramouleesan
bio: Senthil is a senior consultant in the Banking and Financial Services business unit at TCS. He has over 23 years of experience working with banking customers in the US, UK, and Europe. During his career, Senthil has managed customer relationships, program governance, project delivery, and operations. He has delivered business value in several transformation programs for customers in areas of legacy modernization, cost optimization, bank integration, process automation, and cloud migration. Senthil holds a bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering from Anna University, Chennai, India.

name: SENTHIL RAJA JAYARAMAN
designation: Senior Business Consultant and Domain Lead, Internet of Things, Manufacturing, TCS
bio: Senthil is a Senior Business Consultant and Domain Lead, Internet of Things, for Manufacturing in the Asia-Pacific region at TCS. He has more than 12 years of experience across business consulting, program management, business development, and manufacturing engineering. He holds a postgraduate degree in management from the SP Jain Institute of Management and Research, Mumbai, India, and a bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering from the Government College of Technology (Anna University), Coimbatore, India.

name: Serge Pérignon
designation: Global Head, Thought Leadership & Services Marketing, TCS
bio: As the Global Head of TCS Services and the TCS Thought Leadership Institute, Serge Vatin-Perignon has been at the forefront of the global thought leadership movement and technology. With over two decades of experience, he has crafted and executed innovative go-to-marketing strategies that have influenced key business outcomes across large enterprises. At TCS, Serge has built a leading-edge marketing organization focused on technology services while driving impactful thought leadership initiatives centered on AI and other disruptive technologies. Under his leadership, the company also established a distinguished Thought Leadership R&D center, which has produced numerous global studies, white papers, and articles that have positioned TCS as a thought leader in the industry and in leading publications including Forbes and Harvard Business Review. In addition to strategic excellence, Serge is recognized for building and leading high-performance teams that consistently deliver high-impact results. His ability to blend creativity with data-driven insights has been key to delivering transformative marketing solutions on a global scale. As a testament to his success, Serge is frequently invited to speak at industry conferences, sharing his expertise and vision with audiences worldwide. Serge is a global citizen, fluent in English, French and Spanish, a frequent international traveler.

name: Shailendra Jain
designation: Senior Consultant, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Manufacturing, TCS
bio: Shailendra Jain is a thought leader in AI and ML technologies in the manufacturing business unit at TCS. He has over two decades of experience in providing business and technology solutions for several Fortune 500 organizations. Shailendra is a management professional with rich experience in delivering domain-specific ML solutions in sales and marketing, customer experience, parts and services, warranty, finance, and after-sales.

name: Shailesh Seth
designation: Solution Architect, SAP Practice, TCS
bio: Shailesh Seth is a solution architect with the SAP Practice at TCS. He has over 18 years of cross-industry experience in SAP consulting (procurement and warehousing). His focus area is how emerging technologies can be leveraged to address supply chain issues. He holds a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering from Khaja Bandanawaz College of Engineering, Gulbarga, Karnataka, India, and a Post graduate degree in management with a specialization in marketing from the Symbiosis Institute of Management Studies, Pune, Maharashtra, India.

name: Shalini Arora
bio: Shalini Arora heads the User Experience Design Center of excellence for Life Sciences and has more than 21 years IT experience in various domains such as Tansportation , Quality Management, Hi tech, and Life Sciences. Her areas of specialization are Experience Design Strategy definition and deployment, end user testing in User Experience Labs, and Mobile Application development across various platforms. She has filed patent in the areas of mobile technologies and bluetooth devices to create an indoor positioning system. She holds a master’s degree in Computer application and has also been a speaker at the Open group conference for Bluetooth enabled Mobile indoor positioning Systems in Spain

name: Shankar Kausley
designation: Senior Scientist, TCS Research
bio: Venkat heads TCS Financial Solutions, a strategic business unit of TCS. Over the last 27 years, Venkat has performed a variety of roles in the financial services and financial software products business, including product strategy, program management, sales, customer relationship and key account management. In his current role, he is responsible for leading the packaged software products business for financial services, globally, under the brand name, TCS BaNCS.

name: Shankar Narayanan
designation: Business Head, Banking, Financial Services and Insurance for UK, EMEA and APAC Regions, TCS
bio: Shankar Narayanan is the Business Head for Banking, Financial Services and Insurance for UK, EMEA and APAC Regions. Prior to this role, he was the Deputy Head for the Business Transformation Group and was responsible for all service lines within that group. Previously, Shankar also led the Retail, Consumer Goods, Travel, Transportation and Hospitality sectors globally. Shankar joined TCS in 1993 and has held several key leadership positions in the company across operations and management portfolios.

name: Shantanu Talukdar
designation: Chief Innovation Evangelist, BFSI, TCS
bio: Shantanu Talukdar is an Innovation Lead in the Banking and Financial Services business unit at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). He has expertise in artificial intelligence and blockchain technologies and API. Talukdar supports leading organizations across Europe in their innovation initiatives, and is a mentor to various startups. He has over eight years of experience, and holds an MBA in Telecom and Marketing Management from BITM, Pune, India.

name: Sharad Sharma
designation: Domain Consultant- Life Sciences & Healthcare, Clinical Data Management
bio: Sharad Sharma works as a Domain Consultant with the Digital Medicine and Medical Technologies function at Tata Consultancy Services. Sharad comes with 24+ years of Clinical Data management with past experience in global pharma and CRO industries like Pfizer, IQVIA, inVentiv. With over 10 years of people management experience, he has handled and managed end to end clinical data management activities in Start-up, Conduct and Close out phases. He has worked as an SME for database programming in Biometrics team. He has been with TCS for over 10 years as CDM Domain consultant providing expertise in CDM process, solutioning etc,.

name: Sheeba Kizhakkayil
bio: Sheeba Kizhakkayil is part of the Operations and Delivery Excellence team within TCS’ HiTech business unit. With over 23 years of experience, she is responsible for maintaining a single global service standard across the business unit and ensuring that TCS' customers experience certainty and assured service delivery.

name: Shefali Gupta
bio: Shefali Gupta heads the Healthcare Domain Services at TCS. She is responsible for customer relationships, business development and growth, and delivery excellence. With nearly three decades of experience across IT and BPS, Shefali has managed large transformation engagements across multiple industries. She has a rich experience leading large complex programs and driving key initiatives for TCS Healthcare. Shefali holds a Master's degree in Computer Application from Jadavpur University, Kolkata, India.

name: Shekar Krishnan
designation: Vice President and Head of Retail and CPG
bio: Shekar is the Vice President and Head of Retail and Consumer Products Group at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). He has been working in the retail industry for more than 25 years now. In his various leadership roles over the years, he has looked after delivery and has been a client partner for many key TCS customers across the globe. He is a graduate of Jadavpur University and holds a Master’s degree in Technology from the Indian Institute of Technology in Bombay.

name: Shilpa Rao
designation: Platform Head, TCS Optumera™
bio: As an intrapreneur, Shilpa is passionate about combining art and science to improve how businesses make decisions. Shilpa has helped leading Fortune 500 companies reimagine their merchandising processes with TCS Optumera™, AI powered retail optimization suite. She has been responsible for conceptualizing, developing, evangelizing, and executing the products and solutions strategy.

name: Shivashankar Thiagarajan
designation: Consultant, Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance
bio: Shivashankar is a user experience consultant in TCS’ Banking, Financial Services and Insurance (BFSI) business unit. He has over 18 years of experience in customer interactions and user experience (UX). He has successfully helped many BFSI customers in their transformation journeys by putting design thinking approaches into practice.

name: Shiva Gupta
designation: Domain Specialist, Aerospace and Defense, TCS
bio: Shiva is a domain specialist with TCS’ Aerospace and Defense (A&D) business. She supports aerospace customer account teams with market research data, aero training, customer business, and process mapping. She has a Bachelor’s degree in Electronics and Communications Engineering from Anna University, Chennai, India, and an MBA in Finance from the Symbiosis Institute of Management Studies (SIMS), Pune, India.

name: Shivaji Bote
designation: Domain Consultant-Life Sciences, Clinical Data Management
bio: Shivaji Bote comes with total 19+ years of industry experience along with Clinical Data Management functional experience in it. Skilled as Lead Data Manager in multiple EDC applications like InForm, Rave, OC RDC & development of process specific operating guidelines & work instructions etc. He is trained in Veeva Vault CDMS studio & Clinical One 20.3 Randomization and Trial Supply Management. Expertise in study setup, conduct & close out activities of CDM. He published/ contributed 5 research papers in esteemed international and scientific journals. Shivaji has delivered several “Clinical Data Management sessions” at various Pharmacy institute’ s academic forums.

name: Shivratan Gupta
designation: Technical Lead
bio: It’s been an amazing decade as a part of TCS's half-million workforce. Be it learning, mentorship, diverse client engagements or leadership, the opportunity to grow are many!

name: Shivratan Gupta
designation: Technical Lead
bio: Shivratan has been working with TCS’ BFSI clients for over 10 years as a Datawarehouse and Business Intelligence Lead. In the last nine years, he has handled a variety of roles and responsibilities both onshore and off, delivering a dozen reporting applications in collaboration with clients and line of business. Shivratan has an appetite for learning and is a well-known mentor to his peers.

name: Shiwanand Pathak
bio: Shiwanand leads the Data and AI Services practice globally for the Google Business Unit at TCS. He has more than 25 years of diverse leadership experience gained from leading service lines focused on building strategic partnerships and alliances and executing complex digital transformation programs for TCS’ global clients. His work spans digital technologies, consulting, IT-enabled business transformation, and partnering with global enterprises in their strategic growth journeys. He is based out of New Jersey, USA.

name: Dr. Shruti Kunde
designation: Senior Scientist, TCS Research
bio: Dr. Shruti Kunde is part of "Computing Systems Research Group" at TCS. Her research group focusses on High Performance Computing (HPC) involving both software and hardware systems. She is involved in building frameworks and platforms for high performance Machine Learning and Deep Learning applications. Follow Dr. Shruti Kunde on LinkedIn

name: Shwetank Ajay
designation: Consultant, BFSI, TCS
bio: Shwetank Ajay is an observability and monitoring consultant with TCS’ Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit. He has 11 years of work experience with expertise in observability and monitoring solution designing, consulting, customer experience, project management, and information technology infrastructure library (ITIL) services.

name: Shyam Sundar
designation: Delivery Head – Banking and Cards, Business Process Services, BFSI, TCS
bio: Shyam Sundar is the Delivery Head for Payments at TCS Business Process Services Unit. Sundar has over 15 years of experience in the Commercial Banking Payments and Investigations domain. His areas of expertise include business development, process re-engineering, and risk mitigation in banking operations. Sundar has been involved in leading multiple complex transformation and migration projects. He has managed processes such as global mass payments, Worldlink Operations, financial messaging, SWIFTNet process, and multi-currency investigations. Sundar has a Bachelors degree in Physics from Loyola College, and a Masters degree in Computer Applications (MCA) from Madras University.

name: Siddhartha Gigoo
designation: Content and communications specialist, Life sciences
bio: Siddhartha Gigoo is an Experience Design and Communication Strategist with TCS Life Sciences Digital. In a career spanning 20 years, he has worked on several web projects that called for transformation in user experience. He holds a Master’s Degree in Literature and Semiotics from Jawaharlal Nehru University, New Delhi, India.

name: Siddhartha Gupta
designation: Global Lead, Application Modernization, Microsoft Business Unit, TCS
bio: Siddhartha Gupta leads the global Microsoft Azure Platform business at TCS. He has over 20 years of experience in working with global customers in healthcare, publishing, financial services and retail sectors to build applications and systems focused at creating business value. He is a proponent of TCS’ cloud modernization strategy and adoption paths, and evangelizes the adoption of cloud-native applications and integrations for enterprises to drive business benefits.

name: Siddharth Menon
designation: Innovation Lead – Software & Services
bio: Siddharth is a part of Tata Administrative Services (TAS), Tata Group’s flagship leadership program, and is currently leading innovation efforts for the Software and Services industry unit at Tata Consultancy Services. His role involves defining the innovation strategy for the business unit as well as working with clients to identify opportunities for co-innovation with a focus on areas such as the Metaverse, Web 3.0, advanced AI and analytics, and stakeholder experience. Siddharth is a Chartered Accountant by profession and has extensive experience in auditing, taxation, and financial planning and analysis across multiple industries such as logistics, manufacturing, and defense.

name: Simon Warrington
designation: Lead, Domain Advisory, CMI Americas
bio: Simon has held CIO and CTO roles for more than 20 years across many industries from financial services, retail to manufacturing and automotive with organizations such as GE, Cox, Walmart, Linpac, and most recently as CIO, Equifax. Simon specializes in IT transformation and turnaround and large scales acquisitions.

name: Sita Nayak
designation: Head, Consulting & Advisory, Microsoft Security Practice
bio: Sita Nayak heads consulting and advisory services for the security practice at TCS’ Microsoft Business Unit. Sita has 21+ years of IT industry experience covering different technology and industry domains. She has spearheaded multiple Centers of Excellence (CoE) covering IT development, automation, and security. She supports customers in integrating security and compliance in their modern workplace journeys.

name: Dr Sitarama Brahmam
designation: Principal consultant and the head of the Software Product Development (SPD) group at IP&E, Components Engineering Group, TCS
bio: Dr Brahmam is a principal consultant and the head of the SPD group at IP&E, Components Engineering Group, TCS. The SDP group evaluates TCS IP assets to comply with non-functional requirements in conventional and emerging technologies. His current interests include developments in AI; particularly, ethical and trustworthy AI. He is also a member of two ISO working groups.

name: Sivakumar S
designation: Innovation evangelist, TCS
bio: Sivakumar is an innovation evangelist for cybersecurity and privacy research at TCS. He focuses on the packaging and positioning of IP-based assets to address business problems and supports research outcomes toward engineering and scale-up opportunities within business units.

name: Sivakumar Subramanian
bio: Sivakumar Subramanian is a principal scientist with TCS Research. He has 23 years of experience in industrial research and software development. His areas of interest include process systems engineering, process operability, process intensification, and sustainability. He holds a PhD in Chemical Engineering from Lehigh University, PA, USA, and is a senior member of the American Institute of Chemical Engineers (AIChE), USA.

name: Smriti Kirubanandan
designation: Global Director, Growth and Strategic Partnerships, TCS North America
bio: Passionate about driving growth across all industries in North America, Smriti specializes in creating high-impact strategic partnerships that transcend industry verticals. As a trusted leader, she fosters executive relationships and cultivate partnerships at the convergence of emerging technology, innovation, and empathy. Smriti integrates Go-to-Market (GTM) strategies, technology, and inventive solutions to elevate growth trajectories and expand market presence. Smriti has a strong background in robotics and public health and currently serves as a Global Director of Growth and Strategic Partnerships at TCS North America. She specializes in creating high-impact strategic partnerships that transcend industry verticals, fostering executive relationships and cultivating partnerships at the convergence of emerging technology, innovation, and empathy. Her core focus also involves integrating Go-to-Market (GTM) strategies, technology, and inventive solutions to elevate growth trajectories and expand market presence. She also spearheads brand development, thought leadership, and market research. Smriti is a selected Young Global Leader 2023 by the World Economic Forum, a member of the Young Leaders Circle at the Milken Institute, and the Founder of HLTH Forward Podcast. This award-winning media platform hosts healthcare leaders, policymakers, and artists to discuss the challenges in the system and what we could do collectively to move healthcare forward. Smriti holds her Bachelor of Science in Robotics, master’s in engineering management from the University of Southern California, and master’s in public health from the University of California, Los Angeles.

name: Somenath Majumder
bio: Somenath Majumder is the Chief Architect and a team member with the Innovation and Product Engineering - SAP (IPE - SAP) group for ERP on Cloud unit of TCS Platform Solutions. He is proficient in solution architecture and consulting for large scale business transformations using SAP as the ERP software package. As a chief architect, he is responsible for the implementation of several consulting and transformation projects with SAP S/4HANA and other new dimension products involving SAP. He holds a bachelor’s degree in Pharmaceutical Technology from Jadavpur University, Kolkata. He is a certified consultant with six different certifications in various cloud applications of SAP.

name: Somen Das
bio: Somen Das is a cyber security solution architect at TCS. He is a subject matter expert on vulnerability management and application security solutions, with more than 15 years of industry experience. Somen specializes in large application security and vulnerability management programs. He has also been part of large application security transformation projects cutting across environments and technologies, including hybrid cloud.

name: Sonali Fondekar
designation: Innovation Evangelist, TCS
bio: Sonali Fondekar is an Innovation Evangelist at TCS and works on the sustainability aspects of innovation offerings. She has 21 years of IT industry experience across software development, project and delivery management, lab group, Center of Excellence, Business Excellence and Quality.

name: Soumik Paul
bio: Soumik Paul is a developer with five years of experience with the Platform Solutions unit at TCS. He has strong expertise in Python, data science, and machine learning. He is responsible for multiple product engineering and innovations, working as a business intelligence and machine learning engineer. He has been contributing to the development and implementation of predictive analytics and embedded analytics use cases for the homegrown products CHROMA™ and TAP™. He holds a bachelor’s degree in Applied Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering.
